# FHD: adjusted for FXL
## Male FHD
```{r male-fhd-settings}
male_FHD_seed <- SEED + 2000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Retain male individuals with complete FHD and FXL measurements and valid period assignments. Recalculate all standardisation parameters using this FHD analysis sample.

```{r male-fhd-data}
male_FHD_exclusions <- ancient_chi_male %>%
  filter(is.na(FHD) | is.na(FXL))
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_FHD_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_male_FHD <- ancient_chi_male %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(FHD), !is.na(FXL))

male_FHD_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "FHD", "FXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_male_FHD) < 2) stop("At least two male individuals are required for the FHD analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_male_FHD$sex == 0),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_FHD$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_FHD$period),
          !any(ancient_chi_male_FHD$site_id == "SDC"))

for (male_FHD_variable in male_FHD_model_variables) {
  male_FHD_values <- ancient_chi_male_FHD[[male_FHD_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(male_FHD_values) || any(!is.finite(male_FHD_values)) || sd(male_FHD_values) <= 0) {
   stop("Invalid variable in the male FHD model: ", male_FHD_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_male_FHD <- ancient_chi_male_FHD %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    FHD_z           = as.numeric(scale(FHD)),
    FXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(FXL))
  )

male_FHD_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$longitude)
male_FHD_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$longitude)
male_FHD_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$latitude)
male_FHD_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$latitude)
male_FHD_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Mintemp)
male_FHD_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Mintemp)
male_FHD_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Maxtemp)
male_FHD_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Maxtemp)
male_FHD_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Minprecip)
male_FHD_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Minprecip)
male_FHD_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Maxprecip)
male_FHD_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Maxprecip)
male_FHD_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Altitude)
male_FHD_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$Altitude)
mean_fhd_male <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$FHD)
sd_fhd_male   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$FHD)

# Calculate the FXL mean and standard deviation from the FHD analysis sample,
# rather than using the parameters from the preceding FXL model
male_FHD_FXL_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_FHD$FXL)
male_FHD_FXL_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_FHD$FXL)

# Save the standardisation parameters for verification and reproducibility
male_FHD_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = male_FHD_model_variables,
  center = c(male_FHD_longitude_center, male_FHD_latitude_center,
             male_FHD_mintemp_center, male_FHD_maxtemp_center,
             male_FHD_minprecip_center, male_FHD_maxprecip_center,
             male_FHD_altitude_center, mean_fhd_male, male_FHD_FXL_center),
  scale = c(male_FHD_longitude_scale, male_FHD_latitude_scale,
            male_FHD_mintemp_scale, male_FHD_maxtemp_scale,
            male_FHD_minprecip_scale, male_FHD_maxprecip_scale,
            male_FHD_altitude_scale, sd_fhd_male, male_FHD_FXL_scale)
)

# Treat period and site-period group as categorical variables
male_FHD_main_data <- ancient_chi_male_FHD %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

male_FHD_period_levels <- levels(male_FHD_main_data$period)
if (length(male_FHD_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the male FHD model.")
}
contrasts(male_FHD_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(male_FHD_period_levels))

male_FHD_sample_model <- male_FHD_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "male_FHD_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "male_FHD_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, male_FHD_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_FHD_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(male_FHD_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(male_FHD_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(male_FHD_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

Use the same priors and sampling settings as in the FXL analysis. Model FHD_z as the response and include FXL_z as an additional predictor. Save the fitted model under a separate filename.

```{r male-fhd-fit}
male_FHD_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
male_FHD_formula <- bf(
  FHD_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + FXL_z + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_male_FHD_main <- brm(
  formula = male_FHD_formula, data = male_FHD_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = male_FHD_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = male_FHD_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "male_FHD_primary_noSDC"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_FHD_main) == nrow(male_FHD_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

Save posterior and sampler diagnostics and a posterior predictive check plot. Review the diagnostics if any warnings are issued.

```{r male-fhd-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_male_FHD_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_male_FHD_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_model_summary.txt"))

male_FHD_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_FHD_main)
)
nuts_male_FHD <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_FHD_main)
male_FHD_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_male_FHD$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_male_FHD$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_male_FHD$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_male_FHD$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_FHD_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(male_FHD_sampler)
if (any(male_FHD_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_FHD_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_FHD_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    male_FHD_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_FHD_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(male_FHD_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_male_FHD <- pp_check(fit_male_FHD_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_male_FHD)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "male_FHD_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_male_FHD, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates, coordinates, and FXL at their means in the male FHD analysis sample, with FXL_z = 0, and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of FHD in this analysis sample.

```{r male-fhd-period}
ce_time_male_fhd <- conditional_effects(
  fit_male_FHD_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0,
    FXL_z = 0
  )
)
ce_df_male_FHD <- as.data.frame(ce_time_male_fhd$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    FXL_z = 0, FXL_mm = male_FHD_FXL_center,
    median_mm = mean_fhd_male + estimate__ * sd_fhd_male,
    lower90_mm = mean_fhd_male + lower__ * sd_fhd_male,
    upper90_mm = mean_fhd_male + upper__ * sd_fhd_male
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
male_FHD_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_male_FHD, file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_male_fhd <- ggplot(
  ce_df_male_FHD, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted FHD (z-score)",
    breaks = male_FHD_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_fhd_male + . * sd_fhd_male,
      breaks = mean_fhd_male + male_FHD_z_breaks * sd_fhd_male,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted FHD (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_male_fhd)
```

### 5. Environmental and FXL fixed effects

Include the five environmental predictors and FXL. Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively. The FXL coefficient represents the expected change in FHD, expressed in FHD standard deviation units, associated with a one-standard-deviation increase in FXL, conditional on the other model terms.

```{r male-fhd-fixed}
fixef_long_male_fhd <- fit_male_FHD_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled,
                        b_FXL_z) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled", "b_FXL_z"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude", "FXL")
  ))
male_FHD_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_male_fhd %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_environment_and_FXL_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_male_fhd <- ggplot(fixef_long_male_fhd, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = male_FHD_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = male_FHD_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "FHD") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
print(p_fixed_male_fhd)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV.

```{r male-fhd-random}
site_re_male_FHD <- fit_male_FHD_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_male_FHD <- site_re_male_FHD %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_male_FHD <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_male_FHD$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_male_FHD$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_male_FHD$site_id[site_qi90_male_FHD$deviated_90]
)
male_FHD_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_male_FHD %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_male_FHD) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_male_FHD <- male_FHD_site_qi_plot$site_id
male_FHD_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(male_FHD_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_male_FHD)
site_re_plot_male_FHD <- site_re_male_FHD %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_male_FHD) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_male_FHD))
site_qi90_male_FHD <- site_qi90_male_FHD %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_male_FHD)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_male_FHD,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_male_FHD <- ggplot(site_re_plot_male_FHD, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = male_FHD_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = male_FHD_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Male") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_male_FHD)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

Define the prediction area from the sites represented in the male FHD analysis sample and use the preceding grid and environmental extraction settings. Set FXL_z = 0 at every grid point to predict FHD at the mean FXL of this analysis sample.

```{r male-fhd-grid}
male_FHD_sites <- male_FHD_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
male_FHD_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_FHD_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_FHD_hull <- male_FHD_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(male_FHD_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

male_FHD_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
male_FHD_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_FHD_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_FHD_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(male_FHD_grid_points, male_FHD_hull)) > 0
male_FHD_grid_geo <- male_FHD_grid_geo[male_FHD_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(male_FHD_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
male_FHD_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(male_FHD_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
male_FHD_grid_vector <- terra::project(male_FHD_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
male_FHD_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, male_FHD_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
male_FHD_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(male_FHD_grid_geo, male_FHD_grid_environment)
male_FHD_grid_gaps <- male_FHD_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "male_FHD_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(male_FHD_grid_gaps))

male_FHD_grid_scaled_base <- male_FHD_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - male_FHD_longitude_center) / male_FHD_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - male_FHD_latitude_center) / male_FHD_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_FHD_mintemp_center) / male_FHD_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_FHD_maxtemp_center) / male_FHD_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_FHD_minprecip_center) / male_FHD_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_FHD_maxprecip_center) / male_FHD_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_FHD_altitude_center) / male_FHD_altitude_scale,
    FXL_z = 0
  )
if (!nrow(male_FHD_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r male-fhd-predictions}
male_FHD_period_levels <- levels(male_FHD_main_data$period)
male_FHD_period_contrasts <- contrasts(male_FHD_main_data$period)
male_FHD_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_FHD_main))
set.seed(male_FHD_seed + 100L)
male_FHD_draw_ids <- seq_len(male_FHD_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  male_FHD_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(male_FHD_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, male_FHD_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = male_FHD_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_FHD_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

male_FHD_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(male_FHD_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(male_FHD_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
male_FHD_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_FHD_grid_segments))
male_FHD_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_FHD_grid_segments))

for (male_FHD_j in seq_along(male_FHD_grid_segments)) {
  message("Male FHD: predicting chunk ", male_FHD_j, " / ", length(male_FHD_grid_segments))
  male_FHD_chunk <- male_FHD_grid_scaled_base[male_FHD_grid_segments[[male_FHD_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  male_FHD_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(male_FHD_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(male_FHD_chunk))
  male_FHD_period_results <- vector("list", length(male_FHD_period_levels))

  for (male_FHD_k in seq_along(male_FHD_period_levels)) {
    male_FHD_newdata <- male_FHD_chunk
    # The chunk already includes FXL_z = 0; use the same predictor name as in model fitting
    stopifnot(all(male_FHD_newdata$FXL_z == 0))
    male_FHD_newdata$period <- factor(rep(male_FHD_period_levels[male_FHD_k], nrow(male_FHD_chunk)), levels = male_FHD_period_levels)
    contrasts(male_FHD_newdata$period) <- male_FHD_period_contrasts
    male_FHD_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(male_FHD_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(male_FHD_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(male_FHD_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    male_FHD_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_male_FHD_main, newdata = male_FHD_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = male_FHD_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(male_FHD_ep), nrow(male_FHD_ep) == length(male_FHD_draw_ids),
              ncol(male_FHD_ep) == nrow(male_FHD_chunk), all(is.finite(male_FHD_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    male_FHD_mean_draws <- male_FHD_mean_draws + male_FHD_ep / length(male_FHD_period_levels)
    male_FHD_q_period <- apply(male_FHD_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    male_FHD_period_results[[male_FHD_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = male_FHD_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_FHD_chunk$Latitude,
      period = male_FHD_period_levels[male_FHD_k], period_num = match(male_FHD_period_levels[male_FHD_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      FXL_z = 0, FXL_mm = male_FHD_FXL_center,
      male_FHD_epred_median = male_FHD_q_period[2, ],
      male_FHD_epred_lower90 = male_FHD_q_period[1, ],
      male_FHD_epred_upper90 = male_FHD_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  male_FHD_q_all <- apply(male_FHD_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  male_FHD_all_period_chunks[[male_FHD_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = male_FHD_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_FHD_chunk$Latitude,
    med = male_FHD_q_all[2, ], low = male_FHD_q_all[1, ], high = male_FHD_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)",
    FXL_z = 0, FXL_mm = male_FHD_FXL_center
  )
  male_FHD_period_chunks[[male_FHD_j]] <- bind_rows(male_FHD_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_male_FHD <- bind_rows(male_FHD_all_period_chunks)
male_FHD_grid_periods <- bind_rows(male_FHD_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_male_FHD,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_FHD_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_FHD_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_FHD_grid_epred_primary_noSDC_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 11. Optional sensitivity model including SDC commingled remains

Use the existing `run_sdc_sensitivity` switch, which is disabled by default. Require non-missing values for both FHD and FXL. If this comparison is required for the manuscript, set the switch to `TRUE` in Setup and rerun the preceding environmental extraction to ensure that `extraction_source` includes SDC. Use the standardisation parameters from the male primary model for the sensitivity model.

```{r male-fhd-sensitivity}
if (run_sdc_sensitivity) {
  male_FHD_withSDC_data <- extraction_source %>%
    filter(sex == 0, !is.na(FHD), !is.na(FXL)) %>%
    mutate(
      longitude_scaled = (longitude - male_FHD_longitude_center) / male_FHD_longitude_scale,
      latitude_scaled  = (latitude - male_FHD_latitude_center) / male_FHD_latitude_scale,
      mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_FHD_mintemp_center) / male_FHD_mintemp_scale,
      maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_FHD_maxtemp_center) / male_FHD_maxtemp_scale,
      minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_FHD_minprecip_center) / male_FHD_minprecip_scale,
      maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_FHD_maxprecip_center) / male_FHD_maxprecip_scale,
      altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_FHD_altitude_center) / male_FHD_altitude_scale,
      FHD_z = (FHD - mean_fhd_male) / sd_fhd_male,
      FXL_z = (FXL - male_FHD_FXL_center) / male_FHD_FXL_scale,
      period = factor(as.character(period), levels = male_FHD_period_levels), site_id = factor(site_id)
    )
  if (!any(male_FHD_withSDC_data$site_id == "SDC")) {
    stop("There are no SDC individuals available in the data containing SDC; please check whether the environment extraction needs to be re-run")
  }
  if (anyNA(male_FHD_withSDC_data$period)) {
    stop("SDC introduces time periods not included in the primary analysis; therefore, the comparison design must first be examined")
  }
  contrasts(male_FHD_withSDC_data$period) <- contrasts(male_FHD_main_data$period)
  fit_male_FHD_withSDC <- brm(
    formula = male_FHD_formula, data = male_FHD_withSDC_data,
    family = student(), prior = male_FHD_priors,
    iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
    seed = male_FHD_seed + 10L, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control, refresh = 500,
    file = file.path(model_dir, "male_FHD_sensitivity_withSDC"), file_refit = refit_mode
  )
  stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_FHD_withSDC) == nrow(male_FHD_withSDC_data))
  print(summary(fit_male_FHD_withSDC, prob = 0.90))
  male_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
    posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_FHD_withSDC)
  )
  male_FHD_sensitivity_nuts <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_FHD_withSDC)
  male_FHD_sensitivity_sampler <- tibble(
    divergences = sum(male_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Parameter == "divergent__" & male_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Value > 0),
    max_treedepth_hits = sum(male_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                              male_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
  )
  print(male_FHD_sensitivity_sampler)
  if (any(male_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
      any(male_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
      any(male_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
      male_FHD_sensitivity_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_FHD_sensitivity_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
    warning("Convergence or sampling diagnostics for models involving SDC need to be checked")
  }
  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics),
                  file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_withSDC_diagnostics.csv"))
  readr::write_csv(male_FHD_sensitivity_sampler,
                  file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_withSDC_sampler.csv"))
  male_FHD_main_fixed <- as.data.frame(fixef(fit_male_FHD_main, robust = TRUE, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>% mutate(model = "primary_noSDC")
  male_FHD_sensitivity_fixed <- as.data.frame(fixef(fit_male_FHD_withSDC, robust = TRUE, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>% mutate(model = "sensitivity_withSDC")
  readr::write_csv(bind_rows(male_FHD_main_fixed, male_FHD_sensitivity_fixed),
                  file.path(table_dir, "male_FHD_SDC_fixed_effects_comparison.csv"))
}
```

writeLines(

)

## Female FHD

```{r female-fhd-settings}
female_FHD_seed <- SEED + 3000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Retain female individuals with complete FHD and FXL measurements and valid period assignments. Recalculate all standardisation parameters using this FHD analysis sample.

```{r female-fhd-data}
female_FHD_exclusions <- ancient_chi_female %>%
  filter(is.na(FHD) | is.na(FXL) )
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_FHD_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_female_FHD <- ancient_chi_female %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(FHD), !is.na(FXL))

female_FHD_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "FHD", "FXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_female_FHD) < 2) stop("At least two female individuals are required for the FHD analysis.")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_female_FHD$sex == 1),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_FHD$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_FHD$period),
          !any(ancient_chi_female_FHD$site_id == "SDC"))


for (female_FHD_variable in female_FHD_model_variables) {
  female_FHD_values <- ancient_chi_female_FHD[[female_FHD_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(female_FHD_values) || any(!is.finite(female_FHD_values)) || sd(female_FHD_values) <= 0) {
   stop("Invalid variable in the female FHD model: ", female_FHD_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_female_FHD <- ancient_chi_female_FHD %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    FHD_z           = as.numeric(scale(FHD)),
    FXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(FXL))
  )

female_FHD_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$longitude)
female_FHD_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$longitude)
female_FHD_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$latitude)
female_FHD_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$latitude)
female_FHD_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Mintemp)
female_FHD_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Mintemp)
female_FHD_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Maxtemp)
female_FHD_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Maxtemp)
female_FHD_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Minprecip)
female_FHD_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Minprecip)
female_FHD_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Maxprecip)
female_FHD_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Maxprecip)
female_FHD_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Altitude)
female_FHD_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$Altitude)
mean_fhd_female <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$FHD)
sd_fhd_female   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$FHD)

# Calculate the FXL mean and standard deviation from the FHD analysis sample rather than using the parameters from the preceding FXL model
female_FHD_FXL_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_FHD$FXL)
female_FHD_FXL_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_FHD$FXL)

# Save the standardisation parameters for verification and reproducibility
female_FHD_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = female_FHD_model_variables,
  center = c(female_FHD_longitude_center, female_FHD_latitude_center,
             female_FHD_mintemp_center, female_FHD_maxtemp_center,
             female_FHD_minprecip_center, female_FHD_maxprecip_center,
             female_FHD_altitude_center, mean_fhd_female, female_FHD_FXL_center),
  scale = c(female_FHD_longitude_scale, female_FHD_latitude_scale,
            female_FHD_mintemp_scale, female_FHD_maxtemp_scale,
            female_FHD_minprecip_scale, female_FHD_maxprecip_scale,
            female_FHD_altitude_scale, sd_fhd_female, female_FHD_FXL_scale)
)

# Treat period and site-period group as categorical variables
female_FHD_main_data <- ancient_chi_female_FHD %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

female_FHD_period_levels <- levels(female_FHD_main_data$period)
if (length(female_FHD_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the female FHD model")
}
contrasts(female_FHD_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(female_FHD_period_levels))

female_FHD_sample_model <- female_FHD_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "female_FHD_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "female_FHD_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, female_FHD_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_FHD_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(female_FHD_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(female_FHD_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(female_FHD_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

Use the same priors and sampling settings as in the FXL analysis. Model FHD_z as the response and include FXL_z as an additional predictor. Save the fitted model under a separate filename.

```{r female-fhd-fit}
female_FHD_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
female_FHD_formula <- bf(
  FHD_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + FXL_z + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_female_FHD_main <- brm(
  formula = female_FHD_formula, data = female_FHD_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = female_FHD_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = female_FHD_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "female_FHD_primary_noSDC"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_FHD_main) == nrow(female_FHD_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics
Save posterior and sampler diagnostics and a posterior predictive check plot. Review the diagnostics if any warnings are issued.

```{r female-fhd-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_female_FHD_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_female_FHD_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_model_summary.txt"))

female_FHD_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_FHD_main)
)
nuts_female_FHD <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_FHD_main)
female_FHD_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_female_FHD$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_female_FHD$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_female_FHD$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_female_FHD$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_FHD_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(female_FHD_sampler)
if (any(female_FHD_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_FHD_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_FHD_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    female_FHD_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_FHD_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(female_FHD_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_female_FHD <- pp_check(fit_female_FHD_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_female_FHD)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "female_FHD_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_female_FHD, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates, coordinates, and FXL at their means in the female FHD analysis sample, with FXL_z = 0, and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of FHD in this analysis sample.

```{r female-fhd-period}
ce_time_female_fhd <- conditional_effects(
  fit_female_FHD_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0,
    FXL_z = 0
  )
)
ce_df_female_FHD <- as.data.frame(ce_time_female_fhd$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    FXL_z = 0, FXL_mm = female_FHD_FXL_center,
    median_mm = mean_fhd_female + estimate__ * sd_fhd_female,
    lower90_mm = mean_fhd_female + lower__ * sd_fhd_female,
    upper90_mm = mean_fhd_female + upper__ * sd_fhd_female
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
female_FHD_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_female_FHD, file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_female_fhd <- ggplot(
  ce_df_female_FHD, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted FHD (z-score)",
    breaks = female_FHD_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_fhd_female + . * sd_fhd_female,
      breaks = mean_fhd_female + female_FHD_z_breaks * sd_fhd_female,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted FHD (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_female_fhd)
```

### 5. Environmental and FXL fixed effects

Include the five environmental predictors and FXL. Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively. The FXL coefficient represents the expected change in FHD, expressed in FHD standard deviation units, associated with a one-standard-deviation increase in FXL, conditional on the other model terms.

```{r female-fhd-fixed}
fixef_long_female_fhd <- fit_female_FHD_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled,
                        b_FXL_z) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled", "b_FXL_z"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude", "FXL")
  ))
female_FHD_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_female_fhd %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_environment_and_FXL_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_female_fhd <- ggplot(fixef_long_female_fhd, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = female_FHD_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = female_FHD_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
print(p_fixed_female_fhd)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r female-fhd-random}
site_re_female_FHD <- fit_female_FHD_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_female_FHD <- site_re_female_FHD %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_female_FHD <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_female_FHD$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_female_FHD$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_female_FHD$site_id[site_qi90_female_FHD$deviated_90]
)
female_FHD_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_female_FHD %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_female_FHD) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_female_FHD <- female_FHD_site_qi_plot$site_id
female_FHD_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(female_FHD_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_female_FHD)
site_re_plot_female_FHD <- site_re_female_FHD %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_female_FHD) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_female_FHD))
site_qi90_female_FHD <- site_qi90_female_FHD %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_female_FHD)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_female_FHD,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_female_FHD <- ggplot(site_re_plot_female_FHD, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = female_FHD_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = female_FHD_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = NULL, title = "Female") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_female_FHD)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r female-fhd-grid}
female_FHD_sites <- female_FHD_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
female_FHD_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_FHD_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_FHD_hull <- female_FHD_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(female_FHD_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

female_FHD_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
female_FHD_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_FHD_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_FHD_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(female_FHD_grid_points, female_FHD_hull)) > 0
female_FHD_grid_geo <- female_FHD_grid_geo[
  female_FHD_inside, , drop = FALSE
]

if (!nrow(female_FHD_grid_geo)) {
  stop("No prediction grid points remain inside the spatial mask.")
}

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
female_FHD_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(female_FHD_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
female_FHD_grid_vector <- terra::project(female_FHD_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
female_FHD_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, female_FHD_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
female_FHD_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(female_FHD_grid_geo, female_FHD_grid_environment)
female_FHD_grid_gaps <- female_FHD_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "female_FHD_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(female_FHD_grid_gaps))

female_FHD_grid_scaled_base <- female_FHD_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - female_FHD_longitude_center) / female_FHD_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - female_FHD_latitude_center) / female_FHD_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_FHD_mintemp_center) / female_FHD_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_FHD_maxtemp_center) / female_FHD_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_FHD_minprecip_center) / female_FHD_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_FHD_maxprecip_center) / female_FHD_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_FHD_altitude_center) / female_FHD_altitude_scale,
    FXL_z = 0
  )
if (!nrow(female_FHD_grid_scaled_base)) {
  stop("No prediction grid points have complete environmental values.")
}
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r female-fhd-predictions}
female_FHD_period_levels <- levels(female_FHD_main_data$period)
female_FHD_period_contrasts <- contrasts(female_FHD_main_data$period)
female_FHD_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_FHD_main))
set.seed(female_FHD_seed + 100L)
female_FHD_draw_ids <- seq_len(female_FHD_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  female_FHD_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(female_FHD_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, female_FHD_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = female_FHD_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_FHD_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

female_FHD_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(female_FHD_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(female_FHD_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
female_FHD_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_FHD_grid_segments))
female_FHD_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_FHD_grid_segments))

for (female_FHD_j in seq_along(female_FHD_grid_segments)) {
  message("Female FHD: predicting chunk ", female_FHD_j, " / ", length(female_FHD_grid_segments))
  female_FHD_chunk <- female_FHD_grid_scaled_base[female_FHD_grid_segments[[female_FHD_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  female_FHD_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(female_FHD_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(female_FHD_chunk))
  female_FHD_period_results <- vector("list", length(female_FHD_period_levels))

  for (female_FHD_k in seq_along(female_FHD_period_levels)) {
    female_FHD_newdata <- female_FHD_chunk
    # The chunk already includes FXL_z = 0; use the same predictor name as in model fitting
    stopifnot(all(female_FHD_newdata$FXL_z == 0))
    female_FHD_newdata$period <- factor(rep(female_FHD_period_levels[female_FHD_k], nrow(female_FHD_chunk)), levels = female_FHD_period_levels)
    contrasts(female_FHD_newdata$period) <- female_FHD_period_contrasts
    female_FHD_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(female_FHD_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(female_FHD_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(female_FHD_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    female_FHD_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_female_FHD_main, newdata = female_FHD_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = female_FHD_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(female_FHD_ep), nrow(female_FHD_ep) == length(female_FHD_draw_ids),
              ncol(female_FHD_ep) == nrow(female_FHD_chunk), all(is.finite(female_FHD_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    female_FHD_mean_draws <- female_FHD_mean_draws + female_FHD_ep / length(female_FHD_period_levels)
    female_FHD_q_period <- apply(female_FHD_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    female_FHD_period_results[[female_FHD_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = female_FHD_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_FHD_chunk$Latitude,
      period = female_FHD_period_levels[female_FHD_k], period_num = match(female_FHD_period_levels[female_FHD_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      FXL_z = 0, FXL_mm = female_FHD_FXL_center,
      female_FHD_epred_median = female_FHD_q_period[2, ],
      female_FHD_epred_lower90 = female_FHD_q_period[1, ],
      female_FHD_epred_upper90 = female_FHD_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  female_FHD_q_all <- apply(female_FHD_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  female_FHD_all_period_chunks[[female_FHD_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = female_FHD_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_FHD_chunk$Latitude,
    med = female_FHD_q_all[2, ], low = female_FHD_q_all[1, ], high = female_FHD_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)",
    FXL_z = 0, FXL_mm = female_FHD_FXL_center
  )
  female_FHD_period_chunks[[female_FHD_j]] <- bind_rows(female_FHD_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_female_FHD <- bind_rows(female_FHD_all_period_chunks)
female_FHD_grid_periods <- bind_rows(female_FHD_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_female_FHD,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_FHD_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_FHD_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_FHD_grid_epred_primary_noSDC_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 11. Optional sensitivity model including SDC commingled remains

Use the existing `run_sdc_sensitivity` switch, which is disabled by default. Require non-missing values for both FHD and FXL. If this comparison is required for the manuscript, set the switch to `TRUE` in Setup and rerun the preceding environmental extraction to ensure that `extraction_source` includes SDC. Use the standardisation parameters from the female primary model for the sensitivity model.

```{r female-fhd-sensitivity}
if (run_sdc_sensitivity) {
  female_FHD_withSDC_data <- extraction_source %>%
    filter(sex == 1, !is.na(FHD), !is.na(FXL)) %>%
    mutate(
      longitude_scaled = (longitude - female_FHD_longitude_center) / female_FHD_longitude_scale,
      latitude_scaled  = (latitude - female_FHD_latitude_center) / female_FHD_latitude_scale,
      mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_FHD_mintemp_center) / female_FHD_mintemp_scale,
      maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_FHD_maxtemp_center) / female_FHD_maxtemp_scale,
      minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_FHD_minprecip_center) / female_FHD_minprecip_scale,
      maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_FHD_maxprecip_center) / female_FHD_maxprecip_scale,
      altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_FHD_altitude_center) / female_FHD_altitude_scale,
      FHD_z = (FHD - mean_fhd_female) / sd_fhd_female,
      FXL_z = (FXL - female_FHD_FXL_center) / female_FHD_FXL_scale,
      period = factor(as.character(period), levels = female_FHD_period_levels), site_id = factor(site_id)
    )
  if (!any(female_FHD_withSDC_data$site_id == "SDC")) {
    stop("There are no SDC individuals available in the data containing SDC; please check whether the environment extraction needs to be re-run")
  }
  if (anyNA(female_FHD_withSDC_data$period)) {
    stop("SDC introduces time periods not included in the primary analysis; therefore, the comparison design must first be examined")
  }
  contrasts(female_FHD_withSDC_data$period) <- contrasts(female_FHD_main_data$period)
  fit_female_FHD_withSDC <- brm(
    formula = female_FHD_formula, data = female_FHD_withSDC_data,
    family = student(), prior = female_FHD_priors,
    iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
    seed = female_FHD_seed + 10L, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control, refresh = 500,
    file = file.path(model_dir, "female_FHD_sensitivity_withSDC"), file_refit = refit_mode
  )
  stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_FHD_withSDC) == nrow(female_FHD_withSDC_data))
  print(summary(fit_female_FHD_withSDC, prob = 0.90))
  female_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
    posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_FHD_withSDC)
  )
  female_FHD_sensitivity_nuts <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_FHD_withSDC)
  female_FHD_sensitivity_sampler <- tibble(
    divergences = sum(female_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Parameter == "divergent__" & female_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Value > 0),
    max_treedepth_hits = sum(female_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                              female_FHD_sensitivity_nuts$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
  )
  print(female_FHD_sensitivity_sampler)
  if (any(female_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
      any(female_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
      any(female_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
      female_FHD_sensitivity_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_FHD_sensitivity_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
    warning("Convergence or sampling diagnostics for models involving SDC need to be checked")
  }
  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_FHD_sensitivity_diagnostics),
                  file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_withSDC_diagnostics.csv"))
  readr::write_csv(female_FHD_sensitivity_sampler,
                  file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_withSDC_sampler.csv"))
  female_FHD_main_fixed <- as.data.frame(fixef(fit_female_FHD_main, robust = TRUE, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>% mutate(model = "primary_noSDC")
  female_FHD_sensitivity_fixed <- as.data.frame(fixef(fit_female_FHD_withSDC, robust = TRUE, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>% mutate(model = "sensitivity_withSDC")
  readr::write_csv(bind_rows(female_FHD_main_fixed, female_FHD_sensitivity_fixed),
                  file.path(table_dir, "female_FHD_SDC_fixed_effects_comparison.csv"))
}
```
