# TXL, HXL, and RXL: Analyses for males and females

Append this entire section after the male and female FXL/FHD analyses and run it sequentially from top to bottom.

This section contains shared data preparation followed by analyses of male TXL, female TXL, male HXL, female HXL, male RXL, and female RXL. Each analysis includes standardisation, model fitting, diagnostics, period plots, plots of environmental fixed effects, plots of random intercepts for site-period groups, spatial predictions, spatial maps, and PNG/TIFF exports. No additional custom functions are introduced.

SDC has no measurements for these three traits, so no explicit exclusion of SDC or sensitivity model including SDC is required here. Data are drawn directly from `ancient_chi_all` without excluding sites. Individuals with an observed value for the relevant trait and complete chronological information are included in the corresponding model. Separate limb-length data objects are used because the preceding `ancient_chi_male` and `ancient_chi_female` objects already exclude SDC.

First select individuals with at least one of the three limb-length measurements, extract environmental covariates once for the combined sample, and then separate the data by sex. Each model requires an observed value only for its own response trait: the TXL model does not require HXL or RXL measurements, and the same principle applies to the other two traits. FXL measurements are not required. Calculate all standardisation parameters separately for each combination of sex and trait.

Use the same model structure as in the FXL analyses: period, a spatial smooth of longitude and latitude, five environmental covariates, and a random intercept for site-period group. The FXL covariate used in the FHD models is omitted here. Exclude group random intercepts for spatial predictions. Within each posterior draw, average predictions with equal weights across the periods represented in the analysis sample, then summarise the resulting draws using the posterior median and 90% credible interval.


## Shared data preparation: use existing indices and extract environmental covariates

Run this section once to prepare the data for all six models. No sensitivity analysis including SDC is required because no TXL, HXL, or RXL measurements are available for SDC.

If environmental covariates are missing for any individual, save the affected records and halt the analysis for review.

```{r limb-lengths-shared-data}
ancient_chi_limb_source <- ancient_chi_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(TXL) | !is.na(HXL) | !is.na(RXL)) %>%
  select(-any_of(names(climate_paths)))

if (!nrow(ancient_chi_limb_source)) {
  stop("No TXL, HXL, or RXL measurements are available. Please check the source data.")
}


limb_environment_points <- terra::vect(
  as.data.frame(ancient_chi_limb_source),
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326"
)
limb_environment_points <- terra::project(
  limb_environment_points, terra::crs(climate_rasters)
)
limb_environment_values <- terra::extract(
  climate_rasters, limb_environment_points, method = "simple", ID = FALSE
)
stopifnot(nrow(limb_environment_values) == nrow(ancient_chi_limb_source))

ancient_chi_limb_detail <- bind_cols(
  ancient_chi_limb_source, limb_environment_values
)
limb_environment_gaps <- ancient_chi_limb_detail %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(limb_environment_gaps,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_lengths_missing_environment.csv"))
if (nrow(limb_environment_gaps) > 0) {
  stop("Environmental covariates are missing for some individuals in the limb-length sample. See limb_lengths_missing_environment.csv.")
}

readr::write_csv(ancient_chi_limb_detail,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_lengths_data_with_environment.csv"))

ancient_chi_limb_male <- ancient_chi_limb_detail %>% filter(sex == 0)
ancient_chi_limb_female <- ancient_chi_limb_detail %>% filter(sex == 1)

limb_trait_availability <- ancient_chi_limb_detail %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    TXL = sum(!is.na(TXL)), HXL = sum(!is.na(HXL)), RXL = sum(!is.na(RXL)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(limb_trait_availability)
readr::write_csv(limb_trait_availability,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_lengths_trait_availability.csv"))
```

## Male TXL

```{r male-txl-settings}
male_TXL_seed <- SEED + 4000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Retain male individuals with observed TXL measurements and valid period assignments. Calculate all standardisation parameters using the male TXL analysis sample.

```{r male-txl-data}
male_TXL_exclusions <- ancient_chi_limb_male %>%
  filter(is.na(TXL))
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_TXL_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_male_TXL <- ancient_chi_limb_male %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(TXL))

male_TXL_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "TXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_male_TXL) < 2) stop("At least two male individuals are required for the TXL analysis.")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_male_TXL$sex == 0),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_TXL$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_TXL$period))


for (male_TXL_variable in male_TXL_model_variables) {
  male_TXL_values <- ancient_chi_male_TXL[[male_TXL_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(male_TXL_values) || any(!is.finite(male_TXL_values)) || sd(male_TXL_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the male TXL model: ", male_TXL_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_male_TXL <- ancient_chi_male_TXL %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    TXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(TXL))
  )

male_TXL_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$longitude)
male_TXL_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$longitude)
male_TXL_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$latitude)
male_TXL_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$latitude)
male_TXL_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Mintemp)
male_TXL_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Mintemp)
male_TXL_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Maxtemp)
male_TXL_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Maxtemp)
male_TXL_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Minprecip)
male_TXL_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Minprecip)
male_TXL_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Maxprecip)
male_TXL_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Maxprecip)
male_TXL_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Altitude)
male_TXL_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$Altitude)
mean_txl_male <- mean(ancient_chi_male_TXL$TXL)
sd_txl_male   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_TXL$TXL)


male_TXL_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = male_TXL_model_variables,
  center = c(male_TXL_longitude_center, male_TXL_latitude_center,
             male_TXL_mintemp_center, male_TXL_maxtemp_center,
             male_TXL_minprecip_center, male_TXL_maxprecip_center,
             male_TXL_altitude_center, mean_txl_male),
  scale = c(male_TXL_longitude_scale, male_TXL_latitude_scale,
            male_TXL_mintemp_scale, male_TXL_maxtemp_scale,
            male_TXL_minprecip_scale, male_TXL_maxprecip_scale,
            male_TXL_altitude_scale, sd_txl_male)
)


male_TXL_main_data <- ancient_chi_male_TXL %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

male_TXL_period_levels <- levels(male_TXL_main_data$period)
if (length(male_TXL_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the male TXL model.")
}
contrasts(male_TXL_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(male_TXL_period_levels))

male_TXL_sample_model <- male_TXL_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "male_TXL_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "male_TXL_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, male_TXL_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_TXL_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(male_TXL_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(male_TXL_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(male_TXL_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

Use the same model structure, priors, and sampling settings as in the FXL analysis, with TXL_z as the response. Use a separate model filename for each combination of sex and trait.

```{r male-txl-fit}
male_TXL_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
male_TXL_formula <- bf(
  TXL_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_male_TXL_main <- brm(
  formula = male_TXL_formula, data = male_TXL_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = male_TXL_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = male_TXL_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "male_TXL_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_TXL_main) == nrow(male_TXL_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r male-txl-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_male_TXL_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_male_TXL_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_model_summary.txt"))

male_TXL_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_TXL_main)
)
nuts_male_TXL <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_TXL_main)
male_TXL_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_male_TXL$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_male_TXL$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_male_TXL$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_male_TXL$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_TXL_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(male_TXL_sampler)
if (any(male_TXL_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_TXL_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_TXL_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    male_TXL_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_TXL_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(male_TXL_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_male_TXL <- pp_check(fit_male_TXL_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_male_TXL)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "male_TXL_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_male_TXL, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates and coordinates at their means in the male TXL analysis sample and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of TXL in this analysis sample.

```{r male-txl-period}
ce_time_male_txl <- conditional_effects(
  fit_male_TXL_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_male_TXL <- as.data.frame(ce_time_male_txl$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_mm = mean_txl_male + estimate__ * sd_txl_male,
    lower90_mm = mean_txl_male + lower__ * sd_txl_male,
    upper90_mm = mean_txl_male + upper__ * sd_txl_male
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
male_TXL_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_male_TXL, file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_male_txl <- ggplot(
  ce_df_male_TXL, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted TXL (z-score)",
    breaks = male_TXL_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_txl_male + . * sd_txl_male,
      breaks = mean_txl_male + male_TXL_z_breaks * sd_txl_male,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted TXL (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Male") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_male_txl)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r male-txl-fixed}
fixef_long_male_txl <- fit_male_TXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
male_TXL_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_male_txl %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_male_txl <- ggplot(fixef_long_male_txl, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = male_TXL_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = male_TXL_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Male", x = NULL, y = "TXL") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
print(p_fixed_male_txl)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r male-txl-random}
site_re_male_TXL <- fit_male_TXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_male_TXL <- site_re_male_TXL %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_male_TXL <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_male_TXL$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_male_TXL$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_male_TXL$site_id[site_qi90_male_TXL$deviated_90]
)
male_TXL_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_male_TXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_male_TXL) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_male_TXL <- male_TXL_site_qi_plot$site_id
male_TXL_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(male_TXL_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_male_TXL)
site_re_plot_male_TXL <- site_re_male_TXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_male_TXL) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_male_TXL))
site_qi90_male_TXL <- site_qi90_male_TXL %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_male_TXL)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_male_TXL,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_TXL_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_male_TXL <- ggplot(site_re_plot_male_TXL, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = male_TXL_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = male_TXL_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Male") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_male_TXL)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r male-txl-grid}
male_TXL_sites <- male_TXL_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
male_TXL_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_TXL_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_TXL_hull <- male_TXL_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(male_TXL_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

male_TXL_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
male_TXL_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_TXL_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_TXL_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(male_TXL_grid_points, male_TXL_hull)) > 0
male_TXL_grid_geo <- male_TXL_grid_geo[male_TXL_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(male_TXL_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
male_TXL_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(male_TXL_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
male_TXL_grid_vector <- terra::project(male_TXL_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
male_TXL_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, male_TXL_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
male_TXL_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(male_TXL_grid_geo, male_TXL_grid_environment)
male_TXL_grid_gaps <- male_TXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "male_TXL_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(male_TXL_grid_gaps))

male_TXL_grid_scaled_base <- male_TXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - male_TXL_longitude_center) / male_TXL_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - male_TXL_latitude_center) / male_TXL_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_TXL_mintemp_center) / male_TXL_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_TXL_maxtemp_center) / male_TXL_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_TXL_minprecip_center) / male_TXL_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_TXL_maxprecip_center) / male_TXL_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_TXL_altitude_center) / male_TXL_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(male_TXL_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r male-txl-predictions}
male_TXL_period_levels <- levels(male_TXL_main_data$period)
male_TXL_period_contrasts <- contrasts(male_TXL_main_data$period)
male_TXL_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_TXL_main))
set.seed(male_TXL_seed + 100L)
male_TXL_draw_ids <- seq_len(male_TXL_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  male_TXL_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(male_TXL_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, male_TXL_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = male_TXL_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_TXL_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

male_TXL_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(male_TXL_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(male_TXL_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
male_TXL_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_TXL_grid_segments))
male_TXL_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_TXL_grid_segments))

for (male_TXL_j in seq_along(male_TXL_grid_segments)) {
  message("Male TXL: predicting chunk ", male_TXL_j, " / ", length(male_TXL_grid_segments))
  male_TXL_chunk <- male_TXL_grid_scaled_base[male_TXL_grid_segments[[male_TXL_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  male_TXL_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(male_TXL_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(male_TXL_chunk))
  male_TXL_period_results <- vector("list", length(male_TXL_period_levels))

  for (male_TXL_k in seq_along(male_TXL_period_levels)) {
    male_TXL_newdata <- male_TXL_chunk
    male_TXL_newdata$period <- factor(rep(male_TXL_period_levels[male_TXL_k], nrow(male_TXL_chunk)), levels = male_TXL_period_levels)
    contrasts(male_TXL_newdata$period) <- male_TXL_period_contrasts
    male_TXL_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(male_TXL_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(male_TXL_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(male_TXL_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    male_TXL_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_male_TXL_main, newdata = male_TXL_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = male_TXL_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(male_TXL_ep), nrow(male_TXL_ep) == length(male_TXL_draw_ids),
              ncol(male_TXL_ep) == nrow(male_TXL_chunk), all(is.finite(male_TXL_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    male_TXL_mean_draws <- male_TXL_mean_draws + male_TXL_ep / length(male_TXL_period_levels)
    male_TXL_q_period <- apply(male_TXL_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    male_TXL_period_results[[male_TXL_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = male_TXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_TXL_chunk$Latitude,
      period = male_TXL_period_levels[male_TXL_k], period_num = match(male_TXL_period_levels[male_TXL_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      male_TXL_epred_median = male_TXL_q_period[2, ],
      male_TXL_epred_lower90 = male_TXL_q_period[1, ],
      male_TXL_epred_upper90 = male_TXL_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  male_TXL_q_all <- apply(male_TXL_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  male_TXL_all_period_chunks[[male_TXL_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = male_TXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_TXL_chunk$Latitude,
    med = male_TXL_q_all[2, ], low = male_TXL_q_all[1, ], high = male_TXL_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  male_TXL_period_chunks[[male_TXL_j]] <- bind_rows(male_TXL_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_male_TXL <- bind_rows(male_TXL_all_period_chunks)
male_TXL_grid_periods <- bind_rows(male_TXL_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_male_TXL,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_TXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_TXL_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_TXL_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 9. Spatial maps

```{r male-txl-spatial-trends}
pred_all_masked_male_TXL <- readr::read_csv(

  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Site locations in the male TXL analysis sample
sites_male_TXL <- male_TXL_main_data %>%

    longitude = dplyr::first(longitude),
    latitude = dplyr::first(latitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

site_points_layer_male_TXL <- geom_point(

  )

}

common_z_scale_male_TXL <- scale_fill_gradientn(

p_male_TXL_spatial_median <- p_spatial_base_male_TXL +

print(p_male_TXL_spatial_median)

# Lower bound of the 90% credible interval
p_male_TXL_spatial_lower90 <- p_spatial_base_male_TXL +
  geom_tile(

p_male_TXL_spatial_bounds <-
```

### 10. Save all figures
The image files are all written to the `fig_dir` defined in the Setup.

## Female TXL

```{r female-txl-settings}
female_TXL_seed <- SEED + 5000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Retain female individuals with observed TXL measurements and valid period assignments. Calculate all standardisation parameters using the female TXL analysis sample.

```{r female-txl-data}
female_TXL_exclusions <- ancient_chi_limb_female %>%
  filter(is.na(TXL))
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_TXL_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_female_TXL <- ancient_chi_limb_female %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(TXL))

female_TXL_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "TXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_female_TXL) < 2) stop("At least two female individuals are required for the TXL analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_female_TXL$sex == 1),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_TXL$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_TXL$period))


for (female_TXL_variable in female_TXL_model_variables) {
  female_TXL_values <- ancient_chi_female_TXL[[female_TXL_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(female_TXL_values) || any(!is.finite(female_TXL_values)) || sd(female_TXL_values) <= 0) {
   stop("Invalid variable in the female TXL model: ", female_TXL_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_female_TXL <- ancient_chi_female_TXL %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    TXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(TXL))
  )

female_TXL_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$longitude)
female_TXL_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$longitude)
female_TXL_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$latitude)
female_TXL_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$latitude)
female_TXL_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Mintemp)
female_TXL_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Mintemp)
female_TXL_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Maxtemp)
female_TXL_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Maxtemp)
female_TXL_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Minprecip)
female_TXL_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Minprecip)
female_TXL_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Maxprecip)
female_TXL_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Maxprecip)
female_TXL_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Altitude)
female_TXL_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$Altitude)
mean_txl_female <- mean(ancient_chi_female_TXL$TXL)
sd_txl_female   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_TXL$TXL)


female_TXL_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = female_TXL_model_variables,
  center = c(female_TXL_longitude_center, female_TXL_latitude_center,
             female_TXL_mintemp_center, female_TXL_maxtemp_center,
             female_TXL_minprecip_center, female_TXL_maxprecip_center,
             female_TXL_altitude_center, mean_txl_female),
  scale = c(female_TXL_longitude_scale, female_TXL_latitude_scale,
            female_TXL_mintemp_scale, female_TXL_maxtemp_scale,
            female_TXL_minprecip_scale, female_TXL_maxprecip_scale,
            female_TXL_altitude_scale, sd_txl_female)
)


female_TXL_main_data <- ancient_chi_female_TXL %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

female_TXL_period_levels <- levels(female_TXL_main_data$period)
if (length(female_TXL_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the female TXL model")
}
contrasts(female_TXL_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(female_TXL_period_levels))

female_TXL_sample_model <- female_TXL_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "female_TXL_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "female_TXL_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, female_TXL_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_TXL_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(female_TXL_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(female_TXL_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(female_TXL_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

Use the same model structure, priors, and sampling settings as in the FXL analysis, with TXL_z as the response. Use a separate model filename for each combination of sex and trait.

```{r female-txl-fit}
female_TXL_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
female_TXL_formula <- bf(
  TXL_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_female_TXL_main <- brm(
  formula = female_TXL_formula, data = female_TXL_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = female_TXL_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = female_TXL_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "female_TXL_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_TXL_main) == nrow(female_TXL_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r female-txl-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_female_TXL_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_female_TXL_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_model_summary.txt"))

female_TXL_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_TXL_main)
)
nuts_female_TXL <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_TXL_main)
female_TXL_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_female_TXL$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_female_TXL$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_female_TXL$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_female_TXL$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_TXL_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(female_TXL_sampler)
if (any(female_TXL_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_TXL_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_TXL_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    female_TXL_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_TXL_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(female_TXL_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_female_TXL <- pp_check(fit_female_TXL_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_female_TXL)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "female_TXL_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_female_TXL, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates and coordinates at their means in the female TXL analysis sample and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of TXL in this analysis sample.

```{r female-txl-period}
ce_time_female_txl <- conditional_effects(
  fit_female_TXL_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_female_TXL <- as.data.frame(ce_time_female_txl$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_mm = mean_txl_female + estimate__ * sd_txl_female,
    lower90_mm = mean_txl_female + lower__ * sd_txl_female,
    upper90_mm = mean_txl_female + upper__ * sd_txl_female
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
female_TXL_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_female_TXL, file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_female_txl <- ggplot(
  ce_df_female_TXL, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted TXL (z-score)",
    breaks = female_TXL_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_txl_female + . * sd_txl_female,
      breaks = mean_txl_female + female_TXL_z_breaks * sd_txl_female,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted TXL (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Female") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_female_txl)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r female-txl-fixed}
fixef_long_female_txl <- fit_female_TXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
female_TXL_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_female_txl %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_female_txl <- ggplot(fixef_long_female_txl, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = female_TXL_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = female_TXL_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Female", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11))
print(p_fixed_female_txl)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r female-txl-random}
site_re_female_TXL <- fit_female_TXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_female_TXL <- site_re_female_TXL %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_female_TXL <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_female_TXL$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_female_TXL$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_female_TXL$site_id[site_qi90_female_TXL$deviated_90]
)
female_TXL_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_female_TXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_female_TXL) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_female_TXL <- female_TXL_site_qi_plot$site_id
female_TXL_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(female_TXL_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_female_TXL)
site_re_plot_female_TXL <- site_re_female_TXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_female_TXL) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_female_TXL))
site_qi90_female_TXL <- site_qi90_female_TXL %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_female_TXL)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_female_TXL,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_TXL_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_female_TXL <- ggplot(site_re_plot_female_TXL, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = female_TXL_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = female_TXL_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Female") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_female_TXL)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r female-txl-grid}
female_TXL_sites <- female_TXL_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
female_TXL_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_TXL_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_TXL_hull <- female_TXL_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(female_TXL_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

female_TXL_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
female_TXL_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_TXL_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_TXL_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(female_TXL_grid_points, female_TXL_hull)) > 0
female_TXL_grid_geo <- female_TXL_grid_geo[female_TXL_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(female_TXL_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
female_TXL_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(female_TXL_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
female_TXL_grid_vector <- terra::project(female_TXL_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
female_TXL_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, female_TXL_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
female_TXL_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(female_TXL_grid_geo, female_TXL_grid_environment)
female_TXL_grid_gaps <- female_TXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "female_TXL_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(female_TXL_grid_gaps))

female_TXL_grid_scaled_base <- female_TXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - female_TXL_longitude_center) / female_TXL_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - female_TXL_latitude_center) / female_TXL_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_TXL_mintemp_center) / female_TXL_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_TXL_maxtemp_center) / female_TXL_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_TXL_minprecip_center) / female_TXL_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_TXL_maxprecip_center) / female_TXL_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_TXL_altitude_center) / female_TXL_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(female_TXL_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r female-txl-predictions}
female_TXL_period_levels <- levels(female_TXL_main_data$period)
female_TXL_period_contrasts <- contrasts(female_TXL_main_data$period)
female_TXL_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_TXL_main))
set.seed(female_TXL_seed + 100L)
female_TXL_draw_ids <- seq_len(female_TXL_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  female_TXL_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(female_TXL_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, female_TXL_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = female_TXL_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_TXL_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

female_TXL_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(female_TXL_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(female_TXL_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
female_TXL_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_TXL_grid_segments))
female_TXL_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_TXL_grid_segments))

for (female_TXL_j in seq_along(female_TXL_grid_segments)) {
  message("Female TXL: predicting chunk ", female_TXL_j, " / ", length(female_TXL_grid_segments))
  female_TXL_chunk <- female_TXL_grid_scaled_base[female_TXL_grid_segments[[female_TXL_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  female_TXL_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(female_TXL_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(female_TXL_chunk))
  female_TXL_period_results <- vector("list", length(female_TXL_period_levels))

  for (female_TXL_k in seq_along(female_TXL_period_levels)) {
    female_TXL_newdata <- female_TXL_chunk
    female_TXL_newdata$period <- factor(rep(female_TXL_period_levels[female_TXL_k], nrow(female_TXL_chunk)), levels = female_TXL_period_levels)
    contrasts(female_TXL_newdata$period) <- female_TXL_period_contrasts
    female_TXL_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(female_TXL_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(female_TXL_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(female_TXL_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    female_TXL_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_female_TXL_main, newdata = female_TXL_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = female_TXL_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(female_TXL_ep), nrow(female_TXL_ep) == length(female_TXL_draw_ids),
              ncol(female_TXL_ep) == nrow(female_TXL_chunk), all(is.finite(female_TXL_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    female_TXL_mean_draws <- female_TXL_mean_draws + female_TXL_ep / length(female_TXL_period_levels)
    female_TXL_q_period <- apply(female_TXL_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    female_TXL_period_results[[female_TXL_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = female_TXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_TXL_chunk$Latitude,
      period = female_TXL_period_levels[female_TXL_k], period_num = match(female_TXL_period_levels[female_TXL_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      female_TXL_epred_median = female_TXL_q_period[2, ],
      female_TXL_epred_lower90 = female_TXL_q_period[1, ],
      female_TXL_epred_upper90 = female_TXL_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  female_TXL_q_all <- apply(female_TXL_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  female_TXL_all_period_chunks[[female_TXL_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = female_TXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_TXL_chunk$Latitude,
    med = female_TXL_q_all[2, ], low = female_TXL_q_all[1, ], high = female_TXL_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  female_TXL_period_chunks[[female_TXL_j]] <- bind_rows(female_TXL_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_female_TXL <- bind_rows(female_TXL_all_period_chunks)
female_TXL_grid_periods <- bind_rows(female_TXL_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_female_TXL,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_TXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_TXL_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_TXL_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

## Male HXL

```{r male-hxl-settings}
male_HXL_seed <- SEED + 6000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

```{r male-hxl-data}
male_HXL_exclusions <- ancient_chi_limb_male %>%
  filter(is.na(HXL) )
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_HXL_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_male_HXL <- ancient_chi_limb_male %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(HXL))

male_HXL_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "HXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_male_HXL) < 2) stop("At least two male individuals are required for the HXL analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_male_HXL$sex == 0),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_HXL$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_HXL$period))


for (male_HXL_variable in male_HXL_model_variables) {
  male_HXL_values <- ancient_chi_male_HXL[[male_HXL_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(male_HXL_values) || any(!is.finite(male_HXL_values)) || sd(male_HXL_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the male HXL model: ", male_HXL_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_male_HXL <- ancient_chi_male_HXL %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    HXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(HXL))
  )

male_HXL_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$longitude)
male_HXL_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$longitude)
male_HXL_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$latitude)
male_HXL_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$latitude)
male_HXL_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Mintemp)
male_HXL_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Mintemp)
male_HXL_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Maxtemp)
male_HXL_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Maxtemp)
male_HXL_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Minprecip)
male_HXL_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Minprecip)
male_HXL_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Maxprecip)
male_HXL_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Maxprecip)
male_HXL_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Altitude)
male_HXL_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$Altitude)
mean_hxl_male <- mean(ancient_chi_male_HXL$HXL)
sd_hxl_male   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_HXL$HXL)

male_HXL_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = male_HXL_model_variables,
  center = c(male_HXL_longitude_center, male_HXL_latitude_center,
             male_HXL_mintemp_center, male_HXL_maxtemp_center,
             male_HXL_minprecip_center, male_HXL_maxprecip_center,
             male_HXL_altitude_center, mean_hxl_male),
  scale = c(male_HXL_longitude_scale, male_HXL_latitude_scale,
            male_HXL_mintemp_scale, male_HXL_maxtemp_scale,
            male_HXL_minprecip_scale, male_HXL_maxprecip_scale,
            male_HXL_altitude_scale, sd_hxl_male)
)


male_HXL_main_data <- ancient_chi_male_HXL %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

male_HXL_period_levels <- levels(male_HXL_main_data$period)
if (length(male_HXL_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the male HXL model")
}
contrasts(male_HXL_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(male_HXL_period_levels))

male_HXL_sample_model <- male_HXL_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "male_HXL_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "male_HXL_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, male_HXL_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_HXL_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(male_HXL_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(male_HXL_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(male_HXL_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r male-hxl-fit}
male_HXL_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
male_HXL_formula <- bf(
  HXL_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_male_HXL_main <- brm(
  formula = male_HXL_formula, data = male_HXL_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = male_HXL_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = male_HXL_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "male_HXL_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_HXL_main) == nrow(male_HXL_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r male-hxl-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_male_HXL_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_male_HXL_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_model_summary.txt"))

male_HXL_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_HXL_main)
)
nuts_male_HXL <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_HXL_main)
male_HXL_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_male_HXL$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_male_HXL$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_male_HXL$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_male_HXL$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_HXL_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(male_HXL_sampler)
if (any(male_HXL_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_HXL_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_HXL_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    male_HXL_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_HXL_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(male_HXL_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_male_HXL <- pp_check(fit_male_HXL_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_male_HXL)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "male_HXL_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_male_HXL, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates and coordinates at their means in the male HXL analysis sample and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of HXL in this analysis sample.

```{r male-hxl-period}
ce_time_male_hxl <- conditional_effects(
  fit_male_HXL_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_male_HXL <- as.data.frame(ce_time_male_hxl$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_mm = mean_hxl_male + estimate__ * sd_hxl_male,
    lower90_mm = mean_hxl_male + lower__ * sd_hxl_male,
    upper90_mm = mean_hxl_male + upper__ * sd_hxl_male
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
male_HXL_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_male_HXL, file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_male_hxl <- ggplot(
  ce_df_male_HXL, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted HXL (z-score)",
    breaks = male_HXL_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_hxl_male + . * sd_hxl_male,
      breaks = mean_hxl_male + male_HXL_z_breaks * sd_hxl_male,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted HXL (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Male") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_male_hxl)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r male-hxl-fixed}
fixef_long_male_hxl <- fit_male_HXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
male_HXL_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_male_hxl %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_male_hxl <- ggplot(fixef_long_male_hxl, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = male_HXL_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = male_HXL_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "HXL") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
print(p_fixed_male_hxl)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r male-hxl-random}
site_re_male_HXL <- fit_male_HXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_male_HXL <- site_re_male_HXL %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_male_HXL <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_male_HXL$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_male_HXL$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_male_HXL$site_id[site_qi90_male_HXL$deviated_90]
)
male_HXL_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_male_HXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_male_HXL) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_male_HXL <- male_HXL_site_qi_plot$site_id
male_HXL_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(male_HXL_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_male_HXL)
site_re_plot_male_HXL <- site_re_male_HXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_male_HXL) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_male_HXL))
site_qi90_male_HXL <- site_qi90_male_HXL %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_male_HXL)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_male_HXL,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_HXL_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_male_HXL <- ggplot(site_re_plot_male_HXL, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = male_HXL_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = male_HXL_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Male") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_male_HXL)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r male-hxl-grid}
male_HXL_sites <- male_HXL_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
male_HXL_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_HXL_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_HXL_hull <- male_HXL_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(male_HXL_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

male_HXL_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
male_HXL_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_HXL_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_HXL_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(male_HXL_grid_points, male_HXL_hull)) > 0
male_HXL_grid_geo <- male_HXL_grid_geo[male_HXL_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(male_HXL_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
male_HXL_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(male_HXL_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
male_HXL_grid_vector <- terra::project(male_HXL_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
male_HXL_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, male_HXL_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
male_HXL_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(male_HXL_grid_geo, male_HXL_grid_environment)
male_HXL_grid_gaps <- male_HXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "male_HXL_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(male_HXL_grid_gaps))

male_HXL_grid_scaled_base <- male_HXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - male_HXL_longitude_center) / male_HXL_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - male_HXL_latitude_center) / male_HXL_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_HXL_mintemp_center) / male_HXL_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_HXL_maxtemp_center) / male_HXL_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_HXL_minprecip_center) / male_HXL_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_HXL_maxprecip_center) / male_HXL_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_HXL_altitude_center) / male_HXL_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(male_HXL_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r male-hxl-predictions}
male_HXL_period_levels <- levels(male_HXL_main_data$period)
male_HXL_period_contrasts <- contrasts(male_HXL_main_data$period)
male_HXL_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_HXL_main))
set.seed(male_HXL_seed + 100L)
male_HXL_draw_ids <- seq_len(male_HXL_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  male_HXL_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(male_HXL_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, male_HXL_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = male_HXL_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_HXL_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

male_HXL_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(male_HXL_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(male_HXL_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
male_HXL_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_HXL_grid_segments))
male_HXL_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_HXL_grid_segments))

for (male_HXL_j in seq_along(male_HXL_grid_segments)) {
  message("Male HXL: predicting chunk ", male_HXL_j, " / ", length(male_HXL_grid_segments))
  male_HXL_chunk <- male_HXL_grid_scaled_base[male_HXL_grid_segments[[male_HXL_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  male_HXL_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(male_HXL_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(male_HXL_chunk))
  male_HXL_period_results <- vector("list", length(male_HXL_period_levels))

  for (male_HXL_k in seq_along(male_HXL_period_levels)) {
    male_HXL_newdata <- male_HXL_chunk
    male_HXL_newdata$period <- factor(rep(male_HXL_period_levels[male_HXL_k], nrow(male_HXL_chunk)), levels = male_HXL_period_levels)
    contrasts(male_HXL_newdata$period) <- male_HXL_period_contrasts
    male_HXL_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(male_HXL_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(male_HXL_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(male_HXL_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    male_HXL_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_male_HXL_main, newdata = male_HXL_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = male_HXL_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(male_HXL_ep), nrow(male_HXL_ep) == length(male_HXL_draw_ids),
              ncol(male_HXL_ep) == nrow(male_HXL_chunk), all(is.finite(male_HXL_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    male_HXL_mean_draws <- male_HXL_mean_draws + male_HXL_ep / length(male_HXL_period_levels)
    male_HXL_q_period <- apply(male_HXL_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    male_HXL_period_results[[male_HXL_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = male_HXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_HXL_chunk$Latitude,
      period = male_HXL_period_levels[male_HXL_k], period_num = match(male_HXL_period_levels[male_HXL_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      male_HXL_epred_median = male_HXL_q_period[2, ],
      male_HXL_epred_lower90 = male_HXL_q_period[1, ],
      male_HXL_epred_upper90 = male_HXL_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  male_HXL_q_all <- apply(male_HXL_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  male_HXL_all_period_chunks[[male_HXL_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = male_HXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_HXL_chunk$Latitude,
    med = male_HXL_q_all[2, ], low = male_HXL_q_all[1, ], high = male_HXL_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  male_HXL_period_chunks[[male_HXL_j]] <- bind_rows(male_HXL_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_male_HXL <- bind_rows(male_HXL_all_period_chunks)
male_HXL_grid_periods <- bind_rows(male_HXL_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_male_HXL,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_HXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_HXL_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_HXL_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

```{r female-hxl-settings}
female_HXL_seed <- SEED + 7000L
```
