### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

```{r female-hxl-data}
female_HXL_exclusions <- ancient_chi_limb_female %>%
  filter(is.na(HXL))
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_HXL_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_female_HXL <- ancient_chi_limb_female %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(HXL))

female_HXL_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "HXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_female_HXL) < 2) stop("At least two female individuals are required for the HXL analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_female_HXL$sex == 1),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_HXL$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_HXL$period))


for (female_HXL_variable in female_HXL_model_variables) {
  female_HXL_values <- ancient_chi_female_HXL[[female_HXL_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(female_HXL_values) || any(!is.finite(female_HXL_values)) || sd(female_HXL_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the female HXL model: ", female_HXL_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_female_HXL <- ancient_chi_female_HXL %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    HXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(HXL))
  )

female_HXL_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$longitude)
female_HXL_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$longitude)
female_HXL_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$latitude)
female_HXL_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$latitude)
female_HXL_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Mintemp)
female_HXL_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Mintemp)
female_HXL_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Maxtemp)
female_HXL_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Maxtemp)
female_HXL_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Minprecip)
female_HXL_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Minprecip)
female_HXL_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Maxprecip)
female_HXL_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Maxprecip)
female_HXL_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Altitude)
female_HXL_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$Altitude)
mean_hxl_female <- mean(ancient_chi_female_HXL$HXL)
sd_hxl_female   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_HXL$HXL)


female_HXL_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = female_HXL_model_variables,
  center = c(female_HXL_longitude_center, female_HXL_latitude_center,
             female_HXL_mintemp_center, female_HXL_maxtemp_center,
             female_HXL_minprecip_center, female_HXL_maxprecip_center,
             female_HXL_altitude_center, mean_hxl_female),
  scale = c(female_HXL_longitude_scale, female_HXL_latitude_scale,
            female_HXL_mintemp_scale, female_HXL_maxtemp_scale,
            female_HXL_minprecip_scale, female_HXL_maxprecip_scale,
            female_HXL_altitude_scale, sd_hxl_female)
)


female_HXL_main_data <- ancient_chi_female_HXL %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

female_HXL_period_levels <- levels(female_HXL_main_data$period)
if (length(female_HXL_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the female HXL model")
}
contrasts(female_HXL_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(female_HXL_period_levels))

female_HXL_sample_model <- female_HXL_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "female_HXL_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "female_HXL_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, female_HXL_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_HXL_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(female_HXL_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(female_HXL_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(female_HXL_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r female-hxl-fit}
female_HXL_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
female_HXL_formula <- bf(
  HXL_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_female_HXL_main <- brm(
  formula = female_HXL_formula, data = female_HXL_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = female_HXL_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = female_HXL_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "female_HXL_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_HXL_main) == nrow(female_HXL_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r female-hxl-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_female_HXL_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_female_HXL_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_model_summary.txt"))

female_HXL_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_HXL_main)
)
nuts_female_HXL <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_HXL_main)
female_HXL_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_female_HXL$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_female_HXL$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_female_HXL$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_female_HXL$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_HXL_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(female_HXL_sampler)
if (any(female_HXL_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_HXL_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_HXL_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    female_HXL_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_HXL_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(female_HXL_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_female_HXL <- pp_check(fit_female_HXL_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_female_HXL)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "female_HXL_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_female_HXL, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates and coordinates at their means in the female HXL analysis sample and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of HXL in this analysis sample.

```{r female-hxl-period}
ce_time_female_hxl <- conditional_effects(
  fit_female_HXL_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_female_HXL <- as.data.frame(ce_time_female_hxl$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_mm = mean_hxl_female + estimate__ * sd_hxl_female,
    lower90_mm = mean_hxl_female + lower__ * sd_hxl_female,
    upper90_mm = mean_hxl_female + upper__ * sd_hxl_female
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
female_HXL_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_female_HXL, file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_female_hxl <- ggplot(
  ce_df_female_HXL, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted HXL (z-score)",
    breaks = female_HXL_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_hxl_female + . * sd_hxl_female,
      breaks = mean_hxl_female + female_HXL_z_breaks * sd_hxl_female,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted HXL (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Female") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_female_hxl)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r female-hxl-fixed}
fixef_long_female_hxl <- fit_female_HXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
female_HXL_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_female_hxl %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_female_hxl <- ggplot(fixef_long_female_hxl, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = female_HXL_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = female_HXL_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11))
print(p_fixed_female_hxl)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r female-hxl-random}
site_re_female_HXL <- fit_female_HXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_female_HXL <- site_re_female_HXL %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_female_HXL <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_female_HXL$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_female_HXL$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_female_HXL$site_id[site_qi90_female_HXL$deviated_90]
)
female_HXL_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_female_HXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_female_HXL) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_female_HXL <- female_HXL_site_qi_plot$site_id
female_HXL_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(female_HXL_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_female_HXL)
site_re_plot_female_HXL <- site_re_female_HXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_female_HXL) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_female_HXL))
site_qi90_female_HXL <- site_qi90_female_HXL %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_female_HXL)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_female_HXL,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_HXL_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_female_HXL <- ggplot(site_re_plot_female_HXL, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = female_HXL_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = female_HXL_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Female") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_female_HXL)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid
```{r female-hxl-grid}
female_HXL_sites <- female_HXL_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
female_HXL_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_HXL_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_HXL_hull <- female_HXL_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(female_HXL_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

female_HXL_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
female_HXL_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_HXL_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_HXL_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(female_HXL_grid_points, female_HXL_hull)) > 0
female_HXL_grid_geo <- female_HXL_grid_geo[female_HXL_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(female_HXL_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
female_HXL_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(female_HXL_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
female_HXL_grid_vector <- terra::project(female_HXL_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
female_HXL_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, female_HXL_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
female_HXL_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(female_HXL_grid_geo, female_HXL_grid_environment)
female_HXL_grid_gaps <- female_HXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "female_HXL_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(female_HXL_grid_gaps))

female_HXL_grid_scaled_base <- female_HXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - female_HXL_longitude_center) / female_HXL_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - female_HXL_latitude_center) / female_HXL_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_HXL_mintemp_center) / female_HXL_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_HXL_maxtemp_center) / female_HXL_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_HXL_minprecip_center) / female_HXL_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_HXL_maxprecip_center) / female_HXL_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_HXL_altitude_center) / female_HXL_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(female_HXL_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r female-hxl-predictions}
female_HXL_period_levels <- levels(female_HXL_main_data$period)
female_HXL_period_contrasts <- contrasts(female_HXL_main_data$period)
female_HXL_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_HXL_main))
set.seed(female_HXL_seed + 100L)
female_HXL_draw_ids <- seq_len(female_HXL_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  female_HXL_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(female_HXL_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, female_HXL_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = female_HXL_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_HXL_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

female_HXL_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(female_HXL_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(female_HXL_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
female_HXL_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_HXL_grid_segments))
female_HXL_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_HXL_grid_segments))

for (female_HXL_j in seq_along(female_HXL_grid_segments)) {
  message("Female HXL: predicting chunk ", female_HXL_j, " / ", length(female_HXL_grid_segments))
  female_HXL_chunk <- female_HXL_grid_scaled_base[female_HXL_grid_segments[[female_HXL_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  female_HXL_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(female_HXL_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(female_HXL_chunk))
  female_HXL_period_results <- vector("list", length(female_HXL_period_levels))

  for (female_HXL_k in seq_along(female_HXL_period_levels)) {
    female_HXL_newdata <- female_HXL_chunk
    female_HXL_newdata$period <- factor(rep(female_HXL_period_levels[female_HXL_k], nrow(female_HXL_chunk)), levels = female_HXL_period_levels)
    contrasts(female_HXL_newdata$period) <- female_HXL_period_contrasts
    female_HXL_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(female_HXL_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(female_HXL_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(female_HXL_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    female_HXL_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_female_HXL_main, newdata = female_HXL_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = female_HXL_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(female_HXL_ep), nrow(female_HXL_ep) == length(female_HXL_draw_ids),
              ncol(female_HXL_ep) == nrow(female_HXL_chunk), all(is.finite(female_HXL_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    female_HXL_mean_draws <- female_HXL_mean_draws + female_HXL_ep / length(female_HXL_period_levels)
    female_HXL_q_period <- apply(female_HXL_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    female_HXL_period_results[[female_HXL_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = female_HXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_HXL_chunk$Latitude,
      period = female_HXL_period_levels[female_HXL_k], period_num = match(female_HXL_period_levels[female_HXL_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      female_HXL_epred_median = female_HXL_q_period[2, ],
      female_HXL_epred_lower90 = female_HXL_q_period[1, ],
      female_HXL_epred_upper90 = female_HXL_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  female_HXL_q_all <- apply(female_HXL_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  female_HXL_all_period_chunks[[female_HXL_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = female_HXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_HXL_chunk$Latitude,
    med = female_HXL_q_all[2, ], low = female_HXL_q_all[1, ], high = female_HXL_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  female_HXL_period_chunks[[female_HXL_j]] <- bind_rows(female_HXL_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_female_HXL <- bind_rows(female_HXL_all_period_chunks)
female_HXL_grid_periods <- bind_rows(female_HXL_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_female_HXL,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_HXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_HXL_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_HXL_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 9. Spatial maps

```{r female-hxl-spatial-trends}
pred_all_masked_female_HXL <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "female_HXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Site locations in the female HXL analysis sample
sites_female_HXL <- female_HXL_main_data %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    longitude = dplyr::first(longitude),
    latitude = dplyr::first(latitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

site_points_layer_female_HXL <- geom_point(
  data = sites_female_HXL,
  aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  shape = 21, fill = "red", colour = "red",
  stroke = 0.1, size = 0.35, alpha = 0.85
)


if (!exists("dem_plot")) {
  if (!exists("dem_cn")) {
    stop("Run the greyscale basemap preparation code first to create dem_cn")
  }
  female_HXL_dem_factor <- max(
    1L, ceiling(max(ncol(dem_cn) / 1000, nrow(dem_cn) / 800))
  )
  female_HXL_dem_small <- terra::aggregate(
    dem_cn, fact = female_HXL_dem_factor, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE
  )
  dem_plot <- as.data.frame(female_HXL_dem_small, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(dem_plot)[3] <- "grey"
}

female_HXL_z_limits <- c(-2.5, 2.5)
common_z_scale_female_HXL <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "PuOr")),
  limits = female_HXL_z_limits,
  oob = scales::squish,
  name = "z-score",
  na.value = "transparent",
  guide = guide_colourbar(
    direction = "vertical",
    barheight = grid::unit(35, "mm"),
    barwidth = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
    frame.colour = "black",
    ticks.colour = "black"
  )
)

p_spatial_base_female_HXL <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(
    data = dem_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = grey),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey35", guide = "none") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  coord_sf(
    crs = sf::st_crs(4326), default_crs = NULL,
    xlim = c(70, 140), ylim = c(10, 55), expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(70, 130, by = 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 50, by = 20)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white", colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
  )


p_female_HXL_spatial_median <- p_spatial_base_female_HXL +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_female_HXL,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = med)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_female_HXL +
  common_z_scale_female_HXL +
  labs(title = "HXL") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p_female_HXL_spatial_median)

# Lower bound of the 90% credible interval
p_female_HXL_spatial_lower90 <- p_spatial_base_female_HXL +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_female_HXL,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = low)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_female_HXL +
  common_z_scale_female_HXL +
  labs( y = "HXL")

# Upper bound of the 90% credible interval
p_female_HXL_spatial_upper90 <- p_spatial_base_female_HXL +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_female_HXL,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = high)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_female_HXL +
  common_z_scale_female_HXL 

p_female_HXL_spatial_bounds <-
  (p_female_HXL_spatial_lower90 | p_female_HXL_spatial_upper90) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 0)
  )
print(p_female_HXL_spatial_bounds)
```

## Male RXL

```{r male-rxl-settings}
male_RXL_seed <- SEED + 8000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

```{r male-rxl-data}
male_RXL_exclusions <- ancient_chi_limb_male %>%
  filter(is.na(RXL))
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_RXL_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_male_RXL <- ancient_chi_limb_male %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(RXL))

male_RXL_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "RXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_male_RXL) < 2) stop("At least two male individuals are required for the RXL analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_male_RXL$sex == 0),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_RXL$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_RXL$period))


for (male_RXL_variable in male_RXL_model_variables) {
  male_RXL_values <- ancient_chi_male_RXL[[male_RXL_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(male_RXL_values) || any(!is.finite(male_RXL_values)) || sd(male_RXL_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the male RXL model: ", male_RXL_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_male_RXL <- ancient_chi_male_RXL %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    RXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(RXL))
  )

male_RXL_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$longitude)
male_RXL_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$longitude)
male_RXL_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$latitude)
male_RXL_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$latitude)
male_RXL_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Mintemp)
male_RXL_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Mintemp)
male_RXL_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Maxtemp)
male_RXL_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Maxtemp)
male_RXL_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Minprecip)
male_RXL_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Minprecip)
male_RXL_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Maxprecip)
male_RXL_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Maxprecip)
male_RXL_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Altitude)
male_RXL_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$Altitude)
mean_rxl_male <- mean(ancient_chi_male_RXL$RXL)
sd_rxl_male   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_RXL$RXL)


male_RXL_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = male_RXL_model_variables,
  center = c(male_RXL_longitude_center, male_RXL_latitude_center,
             male_RXL_mintemp_center, male_RXL_maxtemp_center,
             male_RXL_minprecip_center, male_RXL_maxprecip_center,
             male_RXL_altitude_center, mean_rxl_male),
  scale = c(male_RXL_longitude_scale, male_RXL_latitude_scale,
            male_RXL_mintemp_scale, male_RXL_maxtemp_scale,
            male_RXL_minprecip_scale, male_RXL_maxprecip_scale,
            male_RXL_altitude_scale, sd_rxl_male)
)


male_RXL_main_data <- ancient_chi_male_RXL %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

male_RXL_period_levels <- levels(male_RXL_main_data$period)
if (length(male_RXL_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the male RXL model")
}
contrasts(male_RXL_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(male_RXL_period_levels))

male_RXL_sample_model <- male_RXL_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "male_RXL_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "male_RXL_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, male_RXL_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_RXL_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(male_RXL_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(male_RXL_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(male_RXL_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r male-rxl-fit}
male_RXL_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
male_RXL_formula <- bf(
  RXL_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_male_RXL_main <- brm(
  formula = male_RXL_formula, data = male_RXL_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = male_RXL_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = male_RXL_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "male_RXL_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_RXL_main) == nrow(male_RXL_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r male-rxl-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_male_RXL_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_male_RXL_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_model_summary.txt"))

male_RXL_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_RXL_main)
)
nuts_male_RXL <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_RXL_main)
male_RXL_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_male_RXL$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_male_RXL$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_male_RXL$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_male_RXL$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_RXL_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(male_RXL_sampler)
if (any(male_RXL_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_RXL_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_RXL_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    male_RXL_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_RXL_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(male_RXL_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_male_RXL <- pp_check(fit_male_RXL_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_male_RXL)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "male_RXL_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_male_RXL, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates and coordinates at their means in the male RXL analysis sample and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of RXL in this analysis sample.

```{r male-rxl-period}
ce_time_male_rxl <- conditional_effects(
  fit_male_RXL_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_male_RXL <- as.data.frame(ce_time_male_rxl$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_mm = mean_rxl_male + estimate__ * sd_rxl_male,
    lower90_mm = mean_rxl_male + lower__ * sd_rxl_male,
    upper90_mm = mean_rxl_male + upper__ * sd_rxl_male
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
male_RXL_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_male_RXL, file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_male_rxl <- ggplot(
  ce_df_male_RXL, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted RXL (z-score)",
    breaks = male_RXL_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_rxl_male + . * sd_rxl_male,
      breaks = mean_rxl_male + male_RXL_z_breaks * sd_rxl_male,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted RXL (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Male") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_male_rxl)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r male-rxl-fixed}
fixef_long_male_rxl <- fit_male_RXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
male_RXL_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_male_rxl %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_male_rxl <- ggplot(fixef_long_male_rxl, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = male_RXL_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = male_RXL_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Standardised coefficient", y = "RXL") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),    
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
print(p_fixed_male_rxl)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r male-rxl-random}
site_re_male_RXL <- fit_male_RXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_male_RXL <- site_re_male_RXL %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_male_RXL <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_male_RXL$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_male_RXL$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_male_RXL$site_id[site_qi90_male_RXL$deviated_90]
)
male_RXL_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_male_RXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_male_RXL) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_male_RXL <- male_RXL_site_qi_plot$site_id
male_RXL_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(male_RXL_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_male_RXL)
site_re_plot_male_RXL <- site_re_male_RXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_male_RXL) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_male_RXL))
site_qi90_male_RXL <- site_qi90_male_RXL %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_male_RXL)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_male_RXL,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_RXL_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_male_RXL <- ggplot(site_re_plot_male_RXL, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = male_RXL_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = male_RXL_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Male") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_male_RXL)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r male-rxl-grid}
male_RXL_sites <- male_RXL_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
male_RXL_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_RXL_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_RXL_hull <- male_RXL_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(male_RXL_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

male_RXL_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
male_RXL_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_RXL_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_RXL_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(male_RXL_grid_points, male_RXL_hull)) > 0
male_RXL_grid_geo <- male_RXL_grid_geo[male_RXL_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(male_RXL_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
male_RXL_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(male_RXL_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
male_RXL_grid_vector <- terra::project(male_RXL_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
male_RXL_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, male_RXL_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
male_RXL_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(male_RXL_grid_geo, male_RXL_grid_environment)
male_RXL_grid_gaps <- male_RXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "male_RXL_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(male_RXL_grid_gaps))

male_RXL_grid_scaled_base <- male_RXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - male_RXL_longitude_center) / male_RXL_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - male_RXL_latitude_center) / male_RXL_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_RXL_mintemp_center) / male_RXL_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_RXL_maxtemp_center) / male_RXL_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_RXL_minprecip_center) / male_RXL_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_RXL_maxprecip_center) / male_RXL_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_RXL_altitude_center) / male_RXL_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(male_RXL_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r male-rxl-predictions}
male_RXL_period_levels <- levels(male_RXL_main_data$period)
male_RXL_period_contrasts <- contrasts(male_RXL_main_data$period)
male_RXL_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_RXL_main))
set.seed(male_RXL_seed + 100L)
male_RXL_draw_ids <- seq_len(male_RXL_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  male_RXL_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(male_RXL_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, male_RXL_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = male_RXL_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_RXL_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

male_RXL_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(male_RXL_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(male_RXL_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
male_RXL_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_RXL_grid_segments))
male_RXL_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_RXL_grid_segments))

for (male_RXL_j in seq_along(male_RXL_grid_segments)) {
  message("Male RXL: predicting chunk ", male_RXL_j, " / ", length(male_RXL_grid_segments))
  male_RXL_chunk <- male_RXL_grid_scaled_base[male_RXL_grid_segments[[male_RXL_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  male_RXL_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(male_RXL_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(male_RXL_chunk))
  male_RXL_period_results <- vector("list", length(male_RXL_period_levels))

  for (male_RXL_k in seq_along(male_RXL_period_levels)) {
    male_RXL_newdata <- male_RXL_chunk
    male_RXL_newdata$period <- factor(rep(male_RXL_period_levels[male_RXL_k], nrow(male_RXL_chunk)), levels = male_RXL_period_levels)
    contrasts(male_RXL_newdata$period) <- male_RXL_period_contrasts
    male_RXL_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(male_RXL_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(male_RXL_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(male_RXL_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    male_RXL_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_male_RXL_main, newdata = male_RXL_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = male_RXL_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(male_RXL_ep), nrow(male_RXL_ep) == length(male_RXL_draw_ids),
              ncol(male_RXL_ep) == nrow(male_RXL_chunk), all(is.finite(male_RXL_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    male_RXL_mean_draws <- male_RXL_mean_draws + male_RXL_ep / length(male_RXL_period_levels)
    male_RXL_q_period <- apply(male_RXL_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    male_RXL_period_results[[male_RXL_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = male_RXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_RXL_chunk$Latitude,
      period = male_RXL_period_levels[male_RXL_k], period_num = match(male_RXL_period_levels[male_RXL_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      male_RXL_epred_median = male_RXL_q_period[2, ],
      male_RXL_epred_lower90 = male_RXL_q_period[1, ],
      male_RXL_epred_upper90 = male_RXL_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  male_RXL_q_all <- apply(male_RXL_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  male_RXL_all_period_chunks[[male_RXL_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = male_RXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_RXL_chunk$Latitude,
    med = male_RXL_q_all[2, ], low = male_RXL_q_all[1, ], high = male_RXL_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  male_RXL_period_chunks[[male_RXL_j]] <- bind_rows(male_RXL_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_male_RXL <- bind_rows(male_RXL_all_period_chunks)
male_RXL_grid_periods <- bind_rows(male_RXL_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_male_RXL,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_RXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_RXL_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_RXL_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

```{r male-rxl-spatial-trends}
p_spatial_base_male_RXL <- ggplot() +

    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey35", guide = "none") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  coord_sf(
    crs = sf::st_crs(4326), default_crs = NULL,
    xlim = c(70, 140), ylim = c(10, 55), expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(70, 130, by = 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 50, by = 20)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white", colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
  )


p_male_RXL_spatial_median <- p_spatial_base_male_RXL +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_male_RXL,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = med)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_male_RXL +
  common_z_scale_male_RXL +
  labs(title = "RXL") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p_male_RXL_spatial_median)

# Lower bound of the 90% credible interval
p_male_RXL_spatial_lower90 <- p_spatial_base_male_RXL +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_male_RXL,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = low)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_male_RXL +
  common_z_scale_male_RXL +
  labs(y = "RXL")

# Upper bound of the 90% credible interval
p_male_RXL_spatial_upper90 <- p_spatial_base_male_RXL +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_male_RXL,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = high)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_male_RXL +
  common_z_scale_male_RXL 

p_male_RXL_spatial_bounds <-
  (p_male_RXL_spatial_lower90 | p_male_RXL_spatial_upper90) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 0)
  )
print(p_male_RXL_spatial_bounds)
```

```{r male-rxl-session-info}
writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),

```

男性 z 分数以男性 RXL 分析样本为基准。男女相同的 z 分数不代表相同的毫米长度；
比较绝对长度时分别使用各自的均值和标准差反变换。
空间区间反映跨时期平均期望 RXL 的不确定性，不是个体观测值的预测区间。


## Female RXL

```{r female-rxl-settings}
female_RXL_seed <- SEED + 9000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

```{r female-rxl-data}
female_RXL_exclusions <- ancient_chi_limb_female %>%
  filter(is.na(RXL) )
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_RXL_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_female_RXL <- ancient_chi_limb_female %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(RXL))

female_RXL_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "RXL")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_female_RXL) < 2) stop("At least two female individuals are required for the RXL analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_female_RXL$sex == 1),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_RXL$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_RXL$period))


for (female_RXL_variable in female_RXL_model_variables) {
  female_RXL_values <- ancient_chi_female_RXL[[female_RXL_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(female_RXL_values) || any(!is.finite(female_RXL_values)) || sd(female_RXL_values) <= 0) {
   stop("Invalid variable in the female RXL model: ", female_RXL_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_female_RXL <- ancient_chi_female_RXL %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    RXL_z           = as.numeric(scale(RXL))
  )

female_RXL_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$longitude)
female_RXL_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$longitude)
female_RXL_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$latitude)
female_RXL_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$latitude)
female_RXL_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Mintemp)
female_RXL_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Mintemp)
female_RXL_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Maxtemp)
female_RXL_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Maxtemp)
female_RXL_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Minprecip)
female_RXL_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Minprecip)
female_RXL_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Maxprecip)
female_RXL_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Maxprecip)
female_RXL_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Altitude)
female_RXL_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$Altitude)
mean_rxl_female <- mean(ancient_chi_female_RXL$RXL)
sd_rxl_female   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_RXL$RXL)


female_RXL_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = female_RXL_model_variables,
  center = c(female_RXL_longitude_center, female_RXL_latitude_center,
             female_RXL_mintemp_center, female_RXL_maxtemp_center,
             female_RXL_minprecip_center, female_RXL_maxprecip_center,
             female_RXL_altitude_center, mean_rxl_female),
  scale = c(female_RXL_longitude_scale, female_RXL_latitude_scale,
            female_RXL_mintemp_scale, female_RXL_maxtemp_scale,
            female_RXL_minprecip_scale, female_RXL_maxprecip_scale,
            female_RXL_altitude_scale, sd_rxl_female)
)


female_RXL_main_data <- ancient_chi_female_RXL %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

female_RXL_period_levels <- levels(female_RXL_main_data$period)
if (length(female_RXL_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the female RXL model")
}
contrasts(female_RXL_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(female_RXL_period_levels))

female_RXL_sample_model <- female_RXL_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "female_RXL_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "female_RXL_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, female_RXL_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_RXL_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(female_RXL_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(female_RXL_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(female_RXL_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r female-rxl-fit}
female_RXL_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
female_RXL_formula <- bf(
  RXL_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_female_RXL_main <- brm(
  formula = female_RXL_formula, data = female_RXL_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = female_RXL_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = female_RXL_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "female_RXL_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_RXL_main) == nrow(female_RXL_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r female-rxl-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_female_RXL_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_female_RXL_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_model_summary.txt"))

female_RXL_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_RXL_main)
)
nuts_female_RXL <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_RXL_main)
female_RXL_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_female_RXL$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_female_RXL$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_female_RXL$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_female_RXL$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_RXL_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(female_RXL_sampler)
if (any(female_RXL_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_RXL_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_RXL_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    female_RXL_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_RXL_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(female_RXL_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_female_RXL <- pp_check(fit_female_RXL_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_female_RXL)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "female_RXL_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_female_RXL, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

Fix environmental covariates and coordinates at their means in the female RXL analysis sample and exclude site random intercepts. The secondary axis converts z-scores to millimetres using the mean and standard deviation of RXL in this analysis sample.

```{r female-rxl-period}
ce_time_female_rxl <- conditional_effects(
  fit_female_RXL_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_female_RXL <- as.data.frame(ce_time_female_rxl$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_mm = mean_rxl_female + estimate__ * sd_rxl_female,
    lower90_mm = mean_rxl_female + lower__ * sd_rxl_female,
    upper90_mm = mean_rxl_female + upper__ * sd_rxl_female
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
female_RXL_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_female_RXL, file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_female_rxl <- ggplot(
  ce_df_female_RXL, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted RXL (z-score)",
    breaks = female_RXL_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_rxl_female + . * sd_rxl_female,
      breaks = mean_rxl_female + female_RXL_z_breaks * sd_rxl_female,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted RXL (mm)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Female") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_female_rxl)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r female-rxl-fixed}
fixef_long_female_rxl <- fit_female_RXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
female_RXL_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_female_rxl %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_female_rxl <- ggplot(fixef_long_female_rxl, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = female_RXL_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = female_RXL_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Standardised coefficient", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
print(p_fixed_female_rxl)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r female-rxl-random}
site_re_female_RXL <- fit_female_RXL_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_female_RXL <- site_re_female_RXL %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_female_RXL <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_female_RXL$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_female_RXL$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_female_RXL$site_id[site_qi90_female_RXL$deviated_90]
)
female_RXL_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_female_RXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_female_RXL) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_female_RXL <- female_RXL_site_qi_plot$site_id
female_RXL_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(female_RXL_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_female_RXL)
site_re_plot_female_RXL <- site_re_female_RXL %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_female_RXL) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_female_RXL))
site_qi90_female_RXL <- site_qi90_female_RXL %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_female_RXL)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_female_RXL,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_RXL_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_female_RXL <- ggplot(site_re_plot_female_RXL, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = female_RXL_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = female_RXL_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Female") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_female_RXL)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r female-rxl-grid}
female_RXL_sites <- female_RXL_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
female_RXL_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_RXL_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_RXL_hull <- female_RXL_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(female_RXL_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

female_RXL_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
female_RXL_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_RXL_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_RXL_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(female_RXL_grid_points, female_RXL_hull)) > 0
female_RXL_grid_geo <- female_RXL_grid_geo[female_RXL_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(female_RXL_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
female_RXL_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(female_RXL_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
female_RXL_grid_vector <- terra::project(female_RXL_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
female_RXL_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, female_RXL_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
female_RXL_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(female_RXL_grid_geo, female_RXL_grid_environment)
female_RXL_grid_gaps <- female_RXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "female_RXL_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(female_RXL_grid_gaps))

female_RXL_grid_scaled_base <- female_RXL_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - female_RXL_longitude_center) / female_RXL_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - female_RXL_latitude_center) / female_RXL_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_RXL_mintemp_center) / female_RXL_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_RXL_maxtemp_center) / female_RXL_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_RXL_minprecip_center) / female_RXL_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_RXL_maxprecip_center) / female_RXL_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_RXL_altitude_center) / female_RXL_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(female_RXL_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r female-rxl-predictions}
female_RXL_period_levels <- levels(female_RXL_main_data$period)
female_RXL_period_contrasts <- contrasts(female_RXL_main_data$period)
female_RXL_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_RXL_main))
set.seed(female_RXL_seed + 100L)
female_RXL_draw_ids <- seq_len(female_RXL_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  female_RXL_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(female_RXL_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, female_RXL_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = female_RXL_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_RXL_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

female_RXL_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(female_RXL_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(female_RXL_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
female_RXL_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_RXL_grid_segments))
female_RXL_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_RXL_grid_segments))

for (female_RXL_j in seq_along(female_RXL_grid_segments)) {
  message("Female RXL: predicting chunk ", female_RXL_j, " / ", length(female_RXL_grid_segments))
  female_RXL_chunk <- female_RXL_grid_scaled_base[female_RXL_grid_segments[[female_RXL_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  female_RXL_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(female_RXL_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(female_RXL_chunk))
  female_RXL_period_results <- vector("list", length(female_RXL_period_levels))

  for (female_RXL_k in seq_along(female_RXL_period_levels)) {
    female_RXL_newdata <- female_RXL_chunk
    female_RXL_newdata$period <- factor(rep(female_RXL_period_levels[female_RXL_k], nrow(female_RXL_chunk)), levels = female_RXL_period_levels)
    contrasts(female_RXL_newdata$period) <- female_RXL_period_contrasts
    female_RXL_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(female_RXL_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(female_RXL_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(female_RXL_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    female_RXL_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_female_RXL_main, newdata = female_RXL_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = female_RXL_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(female_RXL_ep), nrow(female_RXL_ep) == length(female_RXL_draw_ids),
              ncol(female_RXL_ep) == nrow(female_RXL_chunk), all(is.finite(female_RXL_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    female_RXL_mean_draws <- female_RXL_mean_draws + female_RXL_ep / length(female_RXL_period_levels)
    female_RXL_q_period <- apply(female_RXL_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    female_RXL_period_results[[female_RXL_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = female_RXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_RXL_chunk$Latitude,
      period = female_RXL_period_levels[female_RXL_k], period_num = match(female_RXL_period_levels[female_RXL_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      female_RXL_epred_median = female_RXL_q_period[2, ],
      female_RXL_epred_lower90 = female_RXL_q_period[1, ],
      female_RXL_epred_upper90 = female_RXL_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  female_RXL_q_all <- apply(female_RXL_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  female_RXL_all_period_chunks[[female_RXL_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = female_RXL_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_RXL_chunk$Latitude,
    med = female_RXL_q_all[2, ], low = female_RXL_q_all[1, ], high = female_RXL_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  female_RXL_period_chunks[[female_RXL_j]] <- bind_rows(female_RXL_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_female_RXL <- bind_rows(female_RXL_all_period_chunks)
female_RXL_grid_periods <- bind_rows(female_RXL_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample;
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_female_RXL,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_RXL_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_RXL_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_RXL_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```
