# BI and CI: Analyses for males and females

Use the precomputed columns in `ancient_chi_all`:
`BI = 100 * RXL / HXL` and `CI = 100 * TXL / FBL`, where FBL was obtained using `0.995 * FXL - 1.557`.

Retain the original index scale, calculated as the ratio multiplied by 100; for example, an index value of 80 corresponds to a ratio of 0.80.

The secondary axes in the period plots and all back-transformed results are expressed in the original index units, rather than millimetres.

## Shared data preparation: use existing indices and extract environmental covariates

```{r limb-indices-shared-data}
if (!all(c("BI", "CI") %in% names(ancient_chi_all))) {
  stop("Run the preceding code to calculate BI and CI first.")
}
stopifnot(is.numeric(ancient_chi_all$BI), is.numeric(ancient_chi_all$CI))

# Check the precomputed values without recalculating the indices
index_invalid_values <- ancient_chi_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    is.nan(BI) | is.nan(CI) |
      (!is.na(BI) & (!is.finite(BI) | BI <= 0)) |
      (!is.na(CI) & (!is.finite(CI) | CI <= 0))
  )
readr::write_csv(index_invalid_values,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_indices_invalid_values.csv"))
if (nrow(index_invalid_values) > 0) {
  stop("Invalid BI or CI values were detected. See limb_indices_invalid_values.csv and check the original measurements")
}

ancient_chi_index_source <- ancient_chi_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(BI) | !is.na(CI)) %>%
  select(-any_of(names(climate_paths)))

if (!nrow(ancient_chi_index_source)) {
  stop("No BI or CI values are available. Check the preceding index calculations and source data")
}

index_invalid_coordinates <- ancient_chi_index_source %>%
  filter(
    !is.finite(longitude) | !is.finite(latitude) |
      longitude < -180 | longitude > 180 |
      latitude < -90 | latitude > 90
  )
if (nrow(index_invalid_coordinates) > 0) {
  readr::write_csv(index_invalid_coordinates,
                  file.path(audit_dir, "limb_indices_invalid_coordinates.csv"))
  stop("Invalid coordinates were detected for some individuals in the index analysis sample. See limb_indices_invalid_coordinates.csv")
}

index_environment_points <- terra::vect(
  as.data.frame(ancient_chi_index_source),
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326"
)
index_environment_points <- terra::project(
  index_environment_points, terra::crs(climate_rasters)
)
index_environment_values <- terra::extract(
  climate_rasters, index_environment_points, method = "simple", ID = FALSE
)
stopifnot(nrow(index_environment_values) == nrow(ancient_chi_index_source))

ancient_chi_index_detail <- bind_cols(
  ancient_chi_index_source, index_environment_values
)
index_environment_gaps <- ancient_chi_index_detail %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(index_environment_gaps,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_indices_missing_environment.csv"))
if (nrow(index_environment_gaps) > 0) {
  stop("Environmental covariates are missing for some individuals in the index analysis sample. See limb_indices_missing_environment.csv")
}

readr::write_csv(ancient_chi_index_detail,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_indices_data_with_environment.csv"))

ancient_chi_index_male <- ancient_chi_index_detail %>% filter(sex == 0)
ancient_chi_index_female <- ancient_chi_index_detail %>% filter(sex == 1)

index_availability <- ancient_chi_index_detail %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(BI = sum(!is.na(BI)), CI = sum(!is.na(CI)), .groups = "drop")
print(index_availability)
readr::write_csv(index_availability,
                file.path(audit_dir, "limb_indices_availability.csv"))
```

## Male BI

```{r male-bi-settings}
male_BI_seed <- SEED + 10000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Use the precomputed BI column and retain male individuals with observed BI values and valid period assignments. Calculate all standardisation parameters using this analysis sample.

```{r male-bi-data}
male_BI_exclusions <- ancient_chi_index_male %>%
  filter(is.na(BI))
readr::write_csv(male_BI_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_BI_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_male_BI <- ancient_chi_index_male %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(BI))

male_BI_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "BI")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_male_BI) < 2) stop("At least two male individuals are required for the BI analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_male_BI$sex == 0),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_BI$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_BI$period))


for (male_BI_variable in male_BI_model_variables) {
  male_BI_values <- ancient_chi_male_BI[[male_BI_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(male_BI_values) || any(!is.finite(male_BI_values)) || sd(male_BI_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the male BI model: ", male_BI_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_male_BI <- ancient_chi_male_BI %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    BI_z           = as.numeric(scale(BI))
  )

male_BI_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$longitude)
male_BI_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$longitude)
male_BI_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$latitude)
male_BI_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$latitude)
male_BI_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$Mintemp)
male_BI_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$Mintemp)
male_BI_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$Maxtemp)
male_BI_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$Maxtemp)
male_BI_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$Minprecip)
male_BI_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$Minprecip)
male_BI_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$Maxprecip)
male_BI_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$Maxprecip)
male_BI_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$Altitude)
male_BI_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$Altitude)
mean_bi_male <- mean(ancient_chi_male_BI$BI)
sd_bi_male   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_BI$BI)


male_BI_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = male_BI_model_variables,
  center = c(male_BI_longitude_center, male_BI_latitude_center,
             male_BI_mintemp_center, male_BI_maxtemp_center,
             male_BI_minprecip_center, male_BI_maxprecip_center,
             male_BI_altitude_center, mean_bi_male),
  scale = c(male_BI_longitude_scale, male_BI_latitude_scale,
            male_BI_mintemp_scale, male_BI_maxtemp_scale,
            male_BI_minprecip_scale, male_BI_maxprecip_scale,
            male_BI_altitude_scale, sd_bi_male)
)


male_BI_main_data <- ancient_chi_male_BI %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

male_BI_period_levels <- levels(male_BI_main_data$period)
if (length(male_BI_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the male BI model")
}
contrasts(male_BI_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(male_BI_period_levels))

male_BI_sample_model <- male_BI_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "male_BI_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "male_BI_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, male_BI_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_BI_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_BI_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_BI_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(male_BI_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(male_BI_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(male_BI_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r male-bi-fit}
male_BI_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
male_BI_formula <- bf(
  BI_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_male_BI_main <- brm(
  formula = male_BI_formula, data = male_BI_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = male_BI_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = male_BI_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "male_BI_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_BI_main) == nrow(male_BI_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics



```{r male-bi-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_male_BI_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_male_BI_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_model_summary.txt"))

male_BI_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_BI_main)
)
nuts_male_BI <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_BI_main)
male_BI_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_male_BI$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_male_BI$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_male_BI$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_male_BI$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_BI_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_BI_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(male_BI_sampler)
if (any(male_BI_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_BI_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_BI_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    male_BI_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_BI_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(male_BI_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_male_BI <- pp_check(fit_male_BI_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_male_BI)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "male_BI_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_male_BI, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences


```{r male-bi-period}
ce_time_male_bi <- conditional_effects(
  fit_male_BI_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_male_BI <- as.data.frame(ce_time_male_bi$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_index = mean_bi_male + estimate__ * sd_bi_male,
    lower90_index = mean_bi_male + lower__ * sd_bi_male,
    upper90_index = mean_bi_male + upper__ * sd_bi_male
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
male_BI_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_male_BI, file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_male_bi <- ggplot(
  ce_df_male_BI, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted BI (z-score)",
    breaks = male_BI_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_bi_male + . * sd_bi_male,
      breaks = mean_bi_male + male_BI_z_breaks * sd_bi_male,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted BI"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Male") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_male_bi)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r male-bi-fixed}
fixef_long_male_bi <- fit_male_BI_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
male_BI_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_male_bi %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(male_BI_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_male_bi <- ggplot(fixef_long_male_bi, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = male_BI_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = male_BI_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "BI") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
print(p_fixed_male_bi)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r male-bi-random}
site_re_male_BI <- fit_male_BI_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_male_BI <- site_re_male_BI %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_male_BI <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_male_BI$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_male_BI$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_male_BI$site_id[site_qi90_male_BI$deviated_90]
)
male_BI_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_male_BI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_male_BI) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_male_BI <- male_BI_site_qi_plot$site_id
male_BI_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(male_BI_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_male_BI)
site_re_plot_male_BI <- site_re_male_BI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_male_BI) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_male_BI))
site_qi90_male_BI <- site_qi90_male_BI %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_male_BI)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_male_BI,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_BI_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_male_BI <- ggplot(site_re_plot_male_BI, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = male_BI_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = male_BI_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Male") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_male_BI)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r male-bi-grid}
male_BI_sites <- male_BI_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
male_BI_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_BI_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_BI_hull <- male_BI_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(male_BI_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

male_BI_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
male_BI_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_BI_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_BI_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(male_BI_grid_points, male_BI_hull)) > 0
male_BI_grid_geo <- male_BI_grid_geo[male_BI_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(male_BI_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
male_BI_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(male_BI_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
male_BI_grid_vector <- terra::project(male_BI_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
male_BI_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, male_BI_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
male_BI_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(male_BI_grid_geo, male_BI_grid_environment)
male_BI_grid_gaps <- male_BI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(male_BI_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "male_BI_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(male_BI_grid_gaps))

male_BI_grid_scaled_base <- male_BI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - male_BI_longitude_center) / male_BI_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - male_BI_latitude_center) / male_BI_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_BI_mintemp_center) / male_BI_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_BI_maxtemp_center) / male_BI_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_BI_minprecip_center) / male_BI_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_BI_maxprecip_center) / male_BI_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_BI_altitude_center) / male_BI_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(male_BI_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r male-bi-predictions}
male_BI_period_levels <- levels(male_BI_main_data$period)
male_BI_period_contrasts <- contrasts(male_BI_main_data$period)
male_BI_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_BI_main))
set.seed(male_BI_seed + 100L)
male_BI_draw_ids <- seq_len(male_BI_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  male_BI_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(male_BI_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, male_BI_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = male_BI_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_BI_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

male_BI_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(male_BI_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(male_BI_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
male_BI_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_BI_grid_segments))
male_BI_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_BI_grid_segments))

for (male_BI_j in seq_along(male_BI_grid_segments)) {
  message("Male BI: predicting chunk ", male_BI_j, " / ", length(male_BI_grid_segments))
  male_BI_chunk <- male_BI_grid_scaled_base[male_BI_grid_segments[[male_BI_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  male_BI_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(male_BI_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(male_BI_chunk))
  male_BI_period_results <- vector("list", length(male_BI_period_levels))

  for (male_BI_k in seq_along(male_BI_period_levels)) {
    male_BI_newdata <- male_BI_chunk
    male_BI_newdata$period <- factor(rep(male_BI_period_levels[male_BI_k], nrow(male_BI_chunk)), levels = male_BI_period_levels)
    contrasts(male_BI_newdata$period) <- male_BI_period_contrasts
    male_BI_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(male_BI_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(male_BI_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(male_BI_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    male_BI_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_male_BI_main, newdata = male_BI_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = male_BI_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(male_BI_ep), nrow(male_BI_ep) == length(male_BI_draw_ids),
              ncol(male_BI_ep) == nrow(male_BI_chunk), all(is.finite(male_BI_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    male_BI_mean_draws <- male_BI_mean_draws + male_BI_ep / length(male_BI_period_levels)
    male_BI_q_period <- apply(male_BI_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    male_BI_period_results[[male_BI_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = male_BI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_BI_chunk$Latitude,
      period = male_BI_period_levels[male_BI_k], period_num = match(male_BI_period_levels[male_BI_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      male_BI_epred_median = male_BI_q_period[2, ],
      male_BI_epred_lower90 = male_BI_q_period[1, ],
      male_BI_epred_upper90 = male_BI_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  male_BI_q_all <- apply(male_BI_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  male_BI_all_period_chunks[[male_BI_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = male_BI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_BI_chunk$Latitude,
    med = male_BI_q_all[2, ], low = male_BI_q_all[1, ], high = male_BI_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  male_BI_period_chunks[[male_BI_j]] <- bind_rows(male_BI_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_male_BI <- bind_rows(male_BI_all_period_chunks)
male_BI_grid_periods <- bind_rows(male_BI_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample; 
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_male_BI,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_BI_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_BI_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_BI_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 9. Spatial maps

```{r male-bi-spatial-trends}
pred_all_masked_male_BI <- readr::read_csv(

)

# # Site locations in the male analysis sample
sites_male_BI <- male_BI_main_data %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%

site_points_layer_male_BI <- geom_point(

)


if (!exists("dem_plot")) {
  if (!exists("dem_cn")) {
    stop("Run the greyscale basemap preparation code first to create dem_cn")
  }
  male_BI_dem_factor <- max(
    1L, ceiling(max(ncol(dem_cn) / 1000, nrow(dem_cn) / 800))
  )
  male_BI_dem_small <- terra::aggregate(
    dem_cn, fact = male_BI_dem_factor, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE
  )
  dem_plot <- as.data.frame(male_BI_dem_small, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(dem_plot)[3] <- "grey"
}

male_BI_z_limits <- c(-2.5, 2.5)
common_z_scale_male_BI <- scale_fill_gradientn(

)

    legend.background = element_rect(

    ),

  )


p_male_BI_spatial_median <- p_spatial_base_male_BI +

print(p_male_BI_spatial_median)

# Lower bound of the 90% credible interval
p_male_BI_spatial_lower90 <- p_spatial_base_male_BI +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_male_BI,

# Upper bound of the 90% credible interval
p_male_BI_spatial_upper90 <- p_spatial_base_male_BI +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_male_BI,

p_male_BI_spatial_bounds <-
```

## Female BI

```{r female-bi-settings}
female_BI_seed <- SEED + 11000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Use the precomputed BI column and retain female individuals with observed BI values and valid period assignments. Calculate all standardisation parameters using this analysis sample.

```{r female-bi-data}
female_BI_exclusions <- ancient_chi_index_female %>%
  filter(is.na(BI))
readr::write_csv(female_BI_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_BI_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_female_BI <- ancient_chi_index_female %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(BI))

female_BI_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "BI")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_female_BI) < 2) stop("At least two female individuals are required for the BI analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_female_BI$sex == 1),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_BI$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_BI$period))


for (female_BI_variable in female_BI_model_variables) {
  female_BI_values <- ancient_chi_female_BI[[female_BI_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(female_BI_values) || any(!is.finite(female_BI_values)) || sd(female_BI_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the female BI model: ", female_BI_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_female_BI <- ancient_chi_female_BI %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    BI_z           = as.numeric(scale(BI))
  )

female_BI_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$longitude)
female_BI_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$longitude)
female_BI_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$latitude)
female_BI_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$latitude)
female_BI_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$Mintemp)
female_BI_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$Mintemp)
female_BI_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$Maxtemp)
female_BI_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$Maxtemp)
female_BI_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$Minprecip)
female_BI_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$Minprecip)
female_BI_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$Maxprecip)
female_BI_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$Maxprecip)
female_BI_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$Altitude)
female_BI_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$Altitude)
mean_bi_female <- mean(ancient_chi_female_BI$BI)
sd_bi_female   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_BI$BI)


female_BI_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = female_BI_model_variables,
  center = c(female_BI_longitude_center, female_BI_latitude_center,
             female_BI_mintemp_center, female_BI_maxtemp_center,
             female_BI_minprecip_center, female_BI_maxprecip_center,
             female_BI_altitude_center, mean_bi_female),
  scale = c(female_BI_longitude_scale, female_BI_latitude_scale,
            female_BI_mintemp_scale, female_BI_maxtemp_scale,
            female_BI_minprecip_scale, female_BI_maxprecip_scale,
            female_BI_altitude_scale, sd_bi_female)
)


female_BI_main_data <- ancient_chi_female_BI %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

female_BI_period_levels <- levels(female_BI_main_data$period)
if (length(female_BI_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the female BI model")
}
contrasts(female_BI_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(female_BI_period_levels))

female_BI_sample_model <- female_BI_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "female_BI_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "female_BI_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, female_BI_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_BI_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_BI_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_BI_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(female_BI_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(female_BI_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(female_BI_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r female-bi-fit}
female_BI_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
female_BI_formula <- bf(
  BI_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_female_BI_main <- brm(
  formula = female_BI_formula, data = female_BI_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = female_BI_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = female_BI_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "female_BI_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_BI_main) == nrow(female_BI_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r female-bi-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_female_BI_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_female_BI_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_model_summary.txt"))

female_BI_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_BI_main)
)
nuts_female_BI <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_BI_main)
female_BI_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_female_BI$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_female_BI$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_female_BI$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_female_BI$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_BI_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_BI_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(female_BI_sampler)
if (any(female_BI_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_BI_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_BI_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    female_BI_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_BI_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(female_BI_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_female_BI <- pp_check(fit_female_BI_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_female_BI)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "female_BI_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_female_BI, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

```{r female-bi-period}
ce_time_female_bi <- conditional_effects(
  fit_female_BI_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_female_BI <- as.data.frame(ce_time_female_bi$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_index = mean_bi_female + estimate__ * sd_bi_female,
    lower90_index = mean_bi_female + lower__ * sd_bi_female,
    upper90_index = mean_bi_female + upper__ * sd_bi_female
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
female_BI_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_female_BI, file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_female_bi <- ggplot(
  ce_df_female_BI, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted BI (z-score)",
    breaks = female_BI_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_bi_female + . * sd_bi_female,
      breaks = mean_bi_female + female_BI_z_breaks * sd_bi_female,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted BI"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Female") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_female_bi)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r female-bi-fixed}
fixef_long_female_bi <- fit_female_BI_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
female_BI_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_female_bi %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(female_BI_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_female_bi <- ggplot(fixef_long_female_bi, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = female_BI_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = female_BI_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11))
print(p_fixed_female_bi)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r female-bi-random}
site_re_female_BI <- fit_female_BI_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_female_BI <- site_re_female_BI %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_female_BI <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_female_BI$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_female_BI$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_female_BI$site_id[site_qi90_female_BI$deviated_90]
)
female_BI_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_female_BI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_female_BI) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_female_BI <- female_BI_site_qi_plot$site_id
female_BI_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(female_BI_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_female_BI)
site_re_plot_female_BI <- site_re_female_BI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_female_BI) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_female_BI))
site_qi90_female_BI <- site_qi90_female_BI %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_female_BI)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_female_BI,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_BI_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_female_BI <- ggplot(site_re_plot_female_BI, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = female_BI_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = female_BI_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Female") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +

print(p_random_female_BI)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r female-bi-grid}
female_BI_sites <- female_BI_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
female_BI_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_BI_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_BI_hull <- female_BI_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(female_BI_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

female_BI_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
female_BI_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_BI_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_BI_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(female_BI_grid_points, female_BI_hull)) > 0
female_BI_grid_geo <- female_BI_grid_geo[female_BI_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(female_BI_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
female_BI_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(female_BI_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
female_BI_grid_vector <- terra::project(female_BI_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
female_BI_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, female_BI_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
female_BI_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(female_BI_grid_geo, female_BI_grid_environment)
female_BI_grid_gaps <- female_BI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(female_BI_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "female_BI_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(female_BI_grid_gaps))

female_BI_grid_scaled_base <- female_BI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - female_BI_longitude_center) / female_BI_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - female_BI_latitude_center) / female_BI_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_BI_mintemp_center) / female_BI_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_BI_maxtemp_center) / female_BI_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_BI_minprecip_center) / female_BI_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_BI_maxprecip_center) / female_BI_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_BI_altitude_center) / female_BI_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(female_BI_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r female-bi-predictions}
female_BI_period_levels <- levels(female_BI_main_data$period)
female_BI_period_contrasts <- contrasts(female_BI_main_data$period)
female_BI_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_BI_main))
set.seed(female_BI_seed + 100L)
female_BI_draw_ids <- seq_len(female_BI_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  female_BI_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(female_BI_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, female_BI_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = female_BI_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_BI_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

female_BI_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(female_BI_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(female_BI_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
female_BI_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_BI_grid_segments))
female_BI_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_BI_grid_segments))

for (female_BI_j in seq_along(female_BI_grid_segments)) {
  message("Female BI: predicting chunk ", female_BI_j, " / ", length(female_BI_grid_segments))
  female_BI_chunk <- female_BI_grid_scaled_base[female_BI_grid_segments[[female_BI_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  female_BI_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(female_BI_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(female_BI_chunk))
  female_BI_period_results <- vector("list", length(female_BI_period_levels))

  for (female_BI_k in seq_along(female_BI_period_levels)) {
    female_BI_newdata <- female_BI_chunk
    female_BI_newdata$period <- factor(rep(female_BI_period_levels[female_BI_k], nrow(female_BI_chunk)), levels = female_BI_period_levels)
    contrasts(female_BI_newdata$period) <- female_BI_period_contrasts
    female_BI_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(female_BI_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(female_BI_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(female_BI_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    female_BI_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_female_BI_main, newdata = female_BI_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = female_BI_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(female_BI_ep), nrow(female_BI_ep) == length(female_BI_draw_ids),
              ncol(female_BI_ep) == nrow(female_BI_chunk), all(is.finite(female_BI_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    female_BI_mean_draws <- female_BI_mean_draws + female_BI_ep / length(female_BI_period_levels)
    female_BI_q_period <- apply(female_BI_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    female_BI_period_results[[female_BI_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = female_BI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_BI_chunk$Latitude,
      period = female_BI_period_levels[female_BI_k], period_num = match(female_BI_period_levels[female_BI_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      female_BI_epred_median = female_BI_q_period[2, ],
      female_BI_epred_lower90 = female_BI_q_period[1, ],
      female_BI_epred_upper90 = female_BI_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  female_BI_q_all <- apply(female_BI_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  female_BI_all_period_chunks[[female_BI_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = female_BI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_BI_chunk$Latitude,
    med = female_BI_q_all[2, ], low = female_BI_q_all[1, ], high = female_BI_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  female_BI_period_chunks[[female_BI_j]] <- bind_rows(female_BI_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_female_BI <- bind_rows(female_BI_all_period_chunks)
female_BI_grid_periods <- bind_rows(female_BI_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample; 
# do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_female_BI,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_BI_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_BI_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_BI_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

```{r female-bi-save}
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      fig_dir, paste0(female_BI_figure_files[female_BI_i], ".png")
    ),
    plot = female_BI_plots_to_save[[female_BI_i]],
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    width = female_BI_figure_widths[female_BI_i],
    height = female_BI_figure_heights[female_BI_i],
    units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      fig_dir, paste0(female_BI_figure_files[female_BI_i], ".tiff")
    ),
    plot = female_BI_plots_to_save[[female_BI_i]],
    device = ragg::agg_tiff,
    width = female_BI_figure_widths[female_BI_i],
    height = female_BI_figure_heights[female_BI_i],
    units = "in", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white"
  )
}
```

## Male CI

```{r male-ci-settings}
male_CI_seed <- SEED + 12000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Use the precomputed CI column and retain male individuals with observed CI values and valid period assignments. Calculate all standardisation parameters using this analysis sample.

```{r male-ci-data}
male_CI_exclusions <- ancient_chi_index_male %>%
  filter(is.na(CI))
readr::write_csv(male_CI_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_CI_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_male_CI <- ancient_chi_index_male %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(CI))

male_CI_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "CI")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_male_CI) < 2) stop("At least two male individuals are required for the CI analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_male_CI$sex == 0),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_CI$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_male_CI$period))


for (male_CI_variable in male_CI_model_variables) {
  male_CI_values <- ancient_chi_male_CI[[male_CI_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(male_CI_values) || any(!is.finite(male_CI_values)) || sd(male_CI_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the male CI model: ", male_CI_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_male_CI <- ancient_chi_male_CI %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    CI_z           = as.numeric(scale(CI))
  )

male_CI_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$longitude)
male_CI_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$longitude)
male_CI_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$latitude)
male_CI_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$latitude)
male_CI_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$Mintemp)
male_CI_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$Mintemp)
male_CI_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$Maxtemp)
male_CI_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$Maxtemp)
male_CI_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$Minprecip)
male_CI_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$Minprecip)
male_CI_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$Maxprecip)
male_CI_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$Maxprecip)
male_CI_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$Altitude)
male_CI_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$Altitude)
mean_ci_male <- mean(ancient_chi_male_CI$CI)
sd_ci_male   <- sd(ancient_chi_male_CI$CI)


male_CI_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = male_CI_model_variables,
  center = c(male_CI_longitude_center, male_CI_latitude_center,
             male_CI_mintemp_center, male_CI_maxtemp_center,
             male_CI_minprecip_center, male_CI_maxprecip_center,
             male_CI_altitude_center, mean_ci_male),
  scale = c(male_CI_longitude_scale, male_CI_latitude_scale,
            male_CI_mintemp_scale, male_CI_maxtemp_scale,
            male_CI_minprecip_scale, male_CI_maxprecip_scale,
            male_CI_altitude_scale, sd_ci_male)
)


male_CI_main_data <- ancient_chi_male_CI %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

male_CI_period_levels <- levels(male_CI_main_data$period)
if (length(male_CI_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the male CI model")
}
contrasts(male_CI_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(male_CI_period_levels))

male_CI_sample_model <- male_CI_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "male_CI_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "male_CI_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, male_CI_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_CI_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(male_CI_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_CI_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(male_CI_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(male_CI_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(male_CI_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r male-ci-fit}
male_CI_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
male_CI_formula <- bf(
  CI_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_male_CI_main <- brm(
  formula = male_CI_formula, data = male_CI_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = male_CI_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = male_CI_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "male_CI_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_male_CI_main) == nrow(male_CI_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r male-ci-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_male_CI_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_male_CI_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_model_summary.txt"))

male_CI_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_CI_main)
)
nuts_male_CI <- brms::nuts_params(fit_male_CI_main)
male_CI_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_male_CI$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_male_CI$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_male_CI$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_male_CI$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(male_CI_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_CI_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(male_CI_sampler)
if (any(male_CI_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_CI_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(male_CI_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    male_CI_sampler$divergences > 0 || male_CI_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(male_CI_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_male_CI <- pp_check(fit_male_CI_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_male_CI)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "male_CI_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_male_CI, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

```{r male-ci-period}
ce_time_male_ci <- conditional_effects(
  fit_male_CI_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_male_CI <- as.data.frame(ce_time_male_ci$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_index = mean_ci_male + estimate__ * sd_ci_male,
    lower90_index = mean_ci_male + lower__ * sd_ci_male,
    upper90_index = mean_ci_male + upper__ * sd_ci_male
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
male_CI_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_male_CI, file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_male_ci <- ggplot(
  ce_df_male_CI, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted CI (z-score)",
    breaks = male_CI_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_ci_male + . * sd_ci_male,
      breaks = mean_ci_male + male_CI_z_breaks * sd_ci_male,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted CI"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_male_ci)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r male-ci-fixed}
fixef_long_male_ci <- fit_male_CI_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
male_CI_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_male_ci %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(male_CI_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_male_ci <- ggplot(fixef_long_male_ci, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = male_CI_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = male_CI_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Standardised coefficient", y = "CI") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),    
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
print(p_fixed_male_ci)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r male-ci-random}
site_re_male_CI <- fit_male_CI_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_male_CI <- site_re_male_CI %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_male_CI <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_male_CI$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_male_CI$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_male_CI$site_id[site_qi90_male_CI$deviated_90]
)
male_CI_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_male_CI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_male_CI) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_male_CI <- male_CI_site_qi_plot$site_id
male_CI_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(male_CI_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_male_CI)
site_re_plot_male_CI <- site_re_male_CI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_male_CI) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_male_CI))
site_qi90_male_CI <- site_qi90_male_CI %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_male_CI)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_male_CI,
                file.path(table_dir, "male_CI_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_male_CI <- ggplot(site_re_plot_male_CI, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = male_CI_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = male_CI_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Male") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_male_CI)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r male-ci-grid}
male_CI_sites <- male_CI_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
male_CI_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_CI_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_CI_hull <- male_CI_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(male_CI_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

male_CI_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
male_CI_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(male_CI_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
male_CI_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(male_CI_grid_points, male_CI_hull)) > 0
male_CI_grid_geo <- male_CI_grid_geo[male_CI_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(male_CI_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
male_CI_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(male_CI_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
male_CI_grid_vector <- terra::project(male_CI_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
male_CI_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, male_CI_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
male_CI_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(male_CI_grid_geo, male_CI_grid_environment)
male_CI_grid_gaps <- male_CI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(male_CI_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "male_CI_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(male_CI_grid_gaps))

male_CI_grid_scaled_base <- male_CI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - male_CI_longitude_center) / male_CI_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - male_CI_latitude_center) / male_CI_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - male_CI_mintemp_center) / male_CI_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - male_CI_maxtemp_center) / male_CI_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - male_CI_minprecip_center) / male_CI_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - male_CI_maxprecip_center) / male_CI_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - male_CI_altitude_center) / male_CI_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(male_CI_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r male-ci-predictions}
male_CI_period_levels <- levels(male_CI_main_data$period)
male_CI_period_contrasts <- contrasts(male_CI_main_data$period)
male_CI_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_male_CI_main))
set.seed(male_CI_seed + 100L)
male_CI_draw_ids <- seq_len(male_CI_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  male_CI_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(male_CI_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, male_CI_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = male_CI_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "male_CI_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

male_CI_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(male_CI_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(male_CI_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
male_CI_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_CI_grid_segments))
male_CI_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(male_CI_grid_segments))

for (male_CI_j in seq_along(male_CI_grid_segments)) {
  message("Male CI: predicting chunk ", male_CI_j, " / ", length(male_CI_grid_segments))
  male_CI_chunk <- male_CI_grid_scaled_base[male_CI_grid_segments[[male_CI_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  male_CI_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(male_CI_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(male_CI_chunk))
  male_CI_period_results <- vector("list", length(male_CI_period_levels))

  for (male_CI_k in seq_along(male_CI_period_levels)) {
    male_CI_newdata <- male_CI_chunk
    male_CI_newdata$period <- factor(rep(male_CI_period_levels[male_CI_k], nrow(male_CI_chunk)), levels = male_CI_period_levels)
    contrasts(male_CI_newdata$period) <- male_CI_period_contrasts
    male_CI_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(male_CI_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(male_CI_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(male_CI_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    male_CI_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_male_CI_main, newdata = male_CI_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = male_CI_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(male_CI_ep), nrow(male_CI_ep) == length(male_CI_draw_ids),
              ncol(male_CI_ep) == nrow(male_CI_chunk), all(is.finite(male_CI_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    male_CI_mean_draws <- male_CI_mean_draws + male_CI_ep / length(male_CI_period_levels)
    male_CI_q_period <- apply(male_CI_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    male_CI_period_results[[male_CI_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = male_CI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_CI_chunk$Latitude,
      period = male_CI_period_levels[male_CI_k], period_num = match(male_CI_period_levels[male_CI_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      male_CI_epred_median = male_CI_q_period[2, ],
      male_CI_epred_lower90 = male_CI_q_period[1, ],
      male_CI_epred_upper90 = male_CI_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  male_CI_q_all <- apply(male_CI_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  male_CI_all_period_chunks[[male_CI_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = male_CI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = male_CI_chunk$Latitude,
    med = male_CI_q_all[2, ], low = male_CI_q_all[1, ], high = male_CI_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  male_CI_period_chunks[[male_CI_j]] <- bind_rows(male_CI_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_male_CI <- bind_rows(male_CI_all_period_chunks)
male_CI_grid_periods <- bind_rows(male_CI_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample; # do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_male_CI,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_CI_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(male_CI_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "male_CI_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 9. Spatial maps

```{r male-ci-spatial-trends}
pred_all_masked_male_CI <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "male_CI_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# # Site locations in the male analysis sample
sites_male_CI <- male_CI_main_data %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    longitude = dplyr::first(longitude),
    latitude = dplyr::first(latitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

site_points_layer_male_CI <- geom_point(
  data = sites_male_CI,
  aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),

)


if (!exists("dem_plot")) {
  if (!exists("dem_cn")) {

  }
  male_CI_dem_factor <- max(
    1L, ceiling(max(ncol(dem_cn) / 1000, nrow(dem_cn) / 800))

  )
  dem_plot <- as.data.frame(male_CI_dem_small, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

}

male_CI_z_limits <- c(-2.5, 2.5)
common_z_scale_male_CI <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")),

  )

p_spatial_base_male_CI <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(

    ),

p_male_CI_spatial_median <- p_spatial_base_male_CI +

print(p_male_CI_spatial_median)

# Lower bound of the 90% credible interval
p_male_CI_spatial_lower90 <- p_spatial_base_male_CI +

# Upper bound of the 90% credible interval

p_male_CI_spatial_bounds <-
```
