## Female CI

```{r female-ci-settings}
female_CI_seed <- SEED + 13000L
```

### 1. Analysis data and standardisation

Use the precomputed CI column and retain female individuals with observed CI values and valid period assignments. Calculate all standardisation parameters using this analysis sample.

```{r female-ci-data}
female_CI_exclusions <- ancient_chi_index_female %>%
  filter(is.na(CI))
readr::write_csv(female_CI_exclusions,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_CI_missing_trait_or_dates.csv"))

ancient_chi_female_CI <- ancient_chi_index_female %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(CI))

female_CI_model_variables <- c("longitude", "latitude", "Mintemp", "Maxtemp",
                     "Minprecip", "Maxprecip", "Altitude", "CI")
if (nrow(ancient_chi_female_CI) < 2) stop("At least two female individuals are required for the CI analysis")
stopifnot(all(ancient_chi_female_CI$sex == 1),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_CI$site_id),
          !anyNA(ancient_chi_female_CI$period))


for (female_CI_variable in female_CI_model_variables) {
  female_CI_values <- ancient_chi_female_CI[[female_CI_variable]]
  if (!is.numeric(female_CI_values) || any(!is.finite(female_CI_values)) || sd(female_CI_values) <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid variable in the female CI model: ", female_CI_variable)
  }
}

ancient_chi_female_CI <- ancient_chi_female_CI %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(longitude)),
    latitude_scaled  = as.numeric(scale(latitude)),
    mintemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Mintemp)),
    maxtemp_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(Maxtemp)),
    minprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Minprecip)),
    maxprecip_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Maxprecip)),
    altitude_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Altitude)),
    CI_z           = as.numeric(scale(CI))
  )

female_CI_longitude_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$longitude)
female_CI_longitude_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$longitude)
female_CI_latitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$latitude)
female_CI_latitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$latitude)
female_CI_mintemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$Mintemp)
female_CI_mintemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$Mintemp)
female_CI_maxtemp_center   <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$Maxtemp)
female_CI_maxtemp_scale    <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$Maxtemp)
female_CI_minprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$Minprecip)
female_CI_minprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$Minprecip)
female_CI_maxprecip_center <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$Maxprecip)
female_CI_maxprecip_scale  <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$Maxprecip)
female_CI_altitude_center  <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$Altitude)
female_CI_altitude_scale   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$Altitude)
mean_ci_female <- mean(ancient_chi_female_CI$CI)
sd_ci_female   <- sd(ancient_chi_female_CI$CI)


female_CI_scaling <- tibble(
  variable = female_CI_model_variables,
  center = c(female_CI_longitude_center, female_CI_latitude_center,
             female_CI_mintemp_center, female_CI_maxtemp_center,
             female_CI_minprecip_center, female_CI_maxprecip_center,
             female_CI_altitude_center, mean_ci_female),
  scale = c(female_CI_longitude_scale, female_CI_latitude_scale,
            female_CI_mintemp_scale, female_CI_maxtemp_scale,
            female_CI_minprecip_scale, female_CI_maxprecip_scale,
            female_CI_altitude_scale, sd_ci_female)
)


female_CI_main_data <- ancient_chi_female_CI %>%
  mutate(
    period = droplevels(factor(as.character(period), levels = PERIOD_CODES)),
    site_id = factor(site_id)
  )

female_CI_period_levels <- levels(female_CI_main_data$period)
if (length(female_CI_period_levels) < 2) {
  stop("At least two periods with observed data are required for the female CI model")
}
contrasts(female_CI_main_data$period) <- contr.sum(length(female_CI_period_levels))

female_CI_sample_model <- female_CI_main_data %>%
  summarise(stage = "female_CI_primary_model", N = n(),
            male = sum(sex == 0), female = sum(sex == 1),
            site_period_groups = n_distinct(site_id))

sample_flow <- sample_flow %>% filter(stage != "female_CI_primary_model")
sample_flow <- bind_rows(sample_flow, female_CI_sample_model)

readr::write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(audit_dir, "sample_flow.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_CI_scaling,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_primary_scaling.csv")) 
readr::write_csv(female_CI_main_data,
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_CI_primary_model_data.csv")) 

print(female_CI_sample_model) # Final analysis sample summary
print(count(female_CI_main_data, period, name = "N")) # Sample size by period
print(female_CI_scaling) # Means and standard deviations used for standardisation
```

### 2. Fit the primary model

```{r female-ci-fit}
female_CI_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", group = "site_id"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "nu")
)
female_CI_formula <- bf(
  CI_z ~ period + t2(longitude_scaled, latitude_scaled) +
    mintemp_scaled + maxtemp_scaled + minprecip_scaled + maxprecip_scaled +
    altitude_scaled + (1 | site_id)
)
fit_female_CI_main <- brm(
  formula = female_CI_formula, data = female_CI_main_data,
  family = student(), prior = female_CI_priors,
  iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
  seed = female_CI_seed, backend = stan_backend, control = brms_control,
  refresh = 500,
  file = file.path(model_dir, "female_CI_primary"),
  file_refit = refit_mode
)

# Verify that the model uses all individuals in the prepared analysis sample
stopifnot(nobs(fit_female_CI_main) == nrow(female_CI_main_data))
```

### 3. Model diagnostics

```{r female-ci-diagnostics}
print(summary(fit_female_CI_main, prob = 0.90))
writeLines(capture.output(summary(fit_female_CI_main, prob = 0.90)),
           file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_model_summary.txt"))

female_CI_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_CI_main)
)
nuts_female_CI <- brms::nuts_params(fit_female_CI_main)
female_CI_sampler <- tibble(
  divergences = sum(nuts_female_CI$Parameter == "divergent__" &
                     nuts_female_CI$Value > 0),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts_female_CI$Parameter == "treedepth__" &
                            nuts_female_CI$Value >= brms_control$max_treedepth)
)
readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(female_CI_diagnostics),
                file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_posterior_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_CI_sampler,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
print(female_CI_sampler)
if (any(female_CI_diagnostics$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_CI_diagnostics$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    any(female_CI_diagnostics$ess_tail < 400, na.rm = TRUE) ||
    female_CI_sampler$divergences > 0 || female_CI_sampler$max_treedepth_hits > 0) {
  warning("Check model convergence and sampler diagnostics before interpreting the results")
}
set.seed(female_CI_seed + 1L)
p_ppc_female_CI <- pp_check(fit_female_CI_main, ndraws = 100)
print(p_ppc_female_CI)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "female_CI_posterior_predictive_check.png"),
       p_ppc_female_CI, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### 4. Period differences

```{r female-ci-period}
ce_time_female_ci <- conditional_effects(
  fit_female_CI_main, effects = "period", re_formula = NA,
  method = "posterior_epred", prob = 0.90, robust = TRUE,
  conditions = data.frame(
    longitude_scaled = 0, latitude_scaled = 0,
    mintemp_scaled = 0, maxtemp_scaled = 0,
    minprecip_scaled = 0, maxprecip_scaled = 0, altitude_scaled = 0
  )
)
ce_df_female_CI <- as.data.frame(ce_time_female_ci$period) %>%
  mutate(
    period_num = match(as.character(period), PERIOD_CODES),
    median_index = mean_ci_female + estimate__ * sd_ci_female,
    lower90_index = mean_ci_female + lower__ * sd_ci_female,
    upper90_index = mean_ci_female + upper__ * sd_ci_female
  ) %>% arrange(period_num)
female_CI_z_breaks <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
readr::write_csv(ce_df_female_CI, file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_temporal_median_CI90.csv"))

p_time_female_ci <- ggplot(
  ce_df_female_CI, aes(x = period_num, y = estimate__)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(PERIOD_CODES), labels = PERIOD_PLOT_LABELS
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Predicted CI (z-score)",
    breaks = female_CI_z_breaks,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ mean_ci_female + . * sd_ci_female,
      breaks = mean_ci_female + female_CI_z_breaks * sd_ci_female,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      name = "Predicted CI"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, title = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  time_plot_theme

print(p_time_female_ci)
```

### 5. Environmental fixed effects

Points and line segments indicate posterior medians and 90% credible intervals, respectively

```{r female-ci-fixed}
fixef_long_female_ci <- fit_female_CI_main %>%
  tidybayes::gather_draws(b_mintemp_scaled, b_maxtemp_scaled,
                        b_minprecip_scaled, b_maxprecip_scaled, b_altitude_scaled) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(
    .variable,
    levels = c("b_mintemp_scaled", "b_maxtemp_scaled", "b_minprecip_scaled",
               "b_maxprecip_scaled", "b_altitude_scaled"),
    labels = c("Min temp", "Max temp", "Min precip", "Max precip", "Altitude")
  ))
female_CI_fixed_effect_summary <- fixef_long_female_ci %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(.value), lower90 = quantile(.value, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(.value, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_csv(female_CI_fixed_effect_summary,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_environmental_effects_median_CI90.csv"))

p_fixed_female_ci <- ggplot(fixef_long_female_ci, aes(.value, parameter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, fill = "skyblue",
                         alpha = 0.65, slab_colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = female_CI_fixed_effect_summary,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = parameter, yend = parameter),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = female_CI_fixed_effect_summary, aes(x = median, y = parameter),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Standardised coefficient", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text= element_text(size = 11))
print(p_fixed_female_ci)
```

### 6. Site-period group random intercepts

Candidate groups comprise the 15 lowest and 15 highest posterior median random intercepts and any groups whose 90% credible intervals exclude zero. Display at most 60 groups, prioritising those with the largest absolute posterior medians. Save the full results to CSV

```{r female-ci-random}
site_re_female_CI <- fit_female_CI_main %>%
  tidybayes::spread_draws(r_site_id[site_id, Intercept]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(site_id = as.character(site_id), r_site_id = as.numeric(r_site_id))
site_qi90_female_CI <- site_re_female_CI %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(median = median(r_site_id), lower90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.05),
            upper90 = quantile(r_site_id, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deviated_90 = lower90 > 0 | upper90 < 0) %>% arrange(median)
keep_sites_female_CI <- union(
  c(head(site_qi90_female_CI$site_id, 15), tail(site_qi90_female_CI$site_id, 15)),
  site_qi90_female_CI$site_id[site_qi90_female_CI$deviated_90]
)
female_CI_site_qi_plot <- site_qi90_female_CI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% keep_sites_female_CI) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median))) %>% slice_head(n = 60) %>% arrange(median)
site_levels_female_CI <- female_CI_site_qi_plot$site_id
female_CI_site_qi_plot$site_id <- factor(female_CI_site_qi_plot$site_id, levels = site_levels_female_CI)
site_re_plot_female_CI <- site_re_female_CI %>%
  filter(site_id %in% site_levels_female_CI) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id, levels = site_levels_female_CI))
site_qi90_female_CI <- site_qi90_female_CI %>%
  mutate(shown_in_plot = site_id %in% site_levels_female_CI)
readr::write_csv(site_qi90_female_CI,
                file.path(table_dir, "female_CI_all_group_intercepts_median_CI90.csv"))

p_random_female_CI <- ggplot(site_re_plot_female_CI, aes(r_site_id, site_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(point_interval = NULL, height = 0.55,
                         slab_colour = NA, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = female_CI_site_qi_plot,
               aes(x = lower90, xend = upper90, y = site_id, yend = site_id),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(data = female_CI_site_qi_plot, aes(x = median, y = site_id),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Group random intercept (z-score)", y = "Site-period groups", title = "Female") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_random_female_CI)
```

### 7. Spatial prediction grid

```{r female-ci-grid}
female_CI_sites <- female_CI_main_data %>% distinct(site_id, longitude, latitude)
female_CI_site_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_CI_sites, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_CI_hull <- female_CI_site_points %>% sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_convex_hull() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(dist = if (nrow(female_CI_sites) < 3) 30000 else 20000) %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>% sf::st_make_valid()

female_CI_grid_geo <- expand.grid(
  Longitude = seq(70, 140, length.out = grid_resolution),
  Latitude  = seq(10, 60, length.out = grid_resolution)
) %>% as_tibble()
female_CI_grid_points <- sf::st_as_sf(female_CI_grid_geo, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
female_CI_inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(female_CI_grid_points, female_CI_hull)) > 0
female_CI_grid_geo <- female_CI_grid_geo[female_CI_inside, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(female_CI_grid_geo)) stop("There are no grid points within the prediction mask.")

# Use the existing `terra` environment layer directly
female_CI_grid_vector <- terra::vect(as.data.frame(female_CI_grid_geo),
                           geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
female_CI_grid_vector <- terra::project(female_CI_grid_vector, terra::crs(climate_rasters))
female_CI_grid_environment <- terra::extract(climate_rasters, female_CI_grid_vector,
                                   method = "simple", ID = FALSE)
female_CI_grid_scaled_base <- bind_cols(female_CI_grid_geo, female_CI_grid_environment)
female_CI_grid_gaps <- female_CI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(!if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite))
readr::write_csv(female_CI_grid_gaps, file.path(audit_dir, "female_CI_grid_cells_without_environment.csv"))
message("Number of prediction grid points excluded due to missing environmental values:", nrow(female_CI_grid_gaps))

female_CI_grid_scaled_base <- female_CI_grid_scaled_base %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(names(climate_paths)), is.finite)) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude_scaled = (Longitude - female_CI_longitude_center) / female_CI_longitude_scale,
    latitude_scaled  = (Latitude - female_CI_latitude_center) / female_CI_latitude_scale,
    mintemp_scaled   = (Mintemp - female_CI_mintemp_center) / female_CI_mintemp_scale,
    maxtemp_scaled   = (Maxtemp - female_CI_maxtemp_center) / female_CI_maxtemp_scale,
    minprecip_scaled = (Minprecip - female_CI_minprecip_center) / female_CI_minprecip_scale,
    maxprecip_scaled = (Maxprecip - female_CI_maxprecip_center) / female_CI_maxprecip_scale,
    altitude_scaled = (Altitude - female_CI_altitude_center) / female_CI_altitude_scale
  )
if (!nrow(female_CI_grid_scaled_base)) stop("A prediction grid lacking complete environmental values")
```

### 8. Chunked prediction and averaging across periods

```{r female-ci-predictions}
female_CI_period_levels <- levels(female_CI_main_data$period)
female_CI_period_contrasts <- contrasts(female_CI_main_data$period)
female_CI_n_available_draws <- posterior::ndraws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit_female_CI_main))
set.seed(female_CI_seed + 100L)
female_CI_draw_ids <- seq_len(female_CI_n_available_draws)
if (!is.null(prediction_ndraws)) {
  female_CI_draw_ids <- sort(sample.int(female_CI_n_available_draws,
                             min(prediction_ndraws, female_CI_n_available_draws)))
}
readr::write_csv(tibble(draw_id = female_CI_draw_ids),
                file.path(audit_dir, "female_CI_spatial_draw_ids.csv"))

female_CI_grid_segments <- split(seq_len(nrow(female_CI_grid_scaled_base)),
                        ceiling(seq_len(nrow(female_CI_grid_scaled_base)) / prediction_chunk_cells))
female_CI_all_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_CI_grid_segments))
female_CI_period_chunks <- vector("list", length(female_CI_grid_segments))

for (female_CI_j in seq_along(female_CI_grid_segments)) {
  message("Female CI: predicting chunk ", female_CI_j, " / ", length(female_CI_grid_segments))
  female_CI_chunk <- female_CI_grid_scaled_base[female_CI_grid_segments[[female_CI_j]], , drop = FALSE]
  female_CI_mean_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = length(female_CI_draw_ids), ncol = nrow(female_CI_chunk))
  female_CI_period_results <- vector("list", length(female_CI_period_levels))

  for (female_CI_k in seq_along(female_CI_period_levels)) {
    female_CI_newdata <- female_CI_chunk
    female_CI_newdata$period <- factor(rep(female_CI_period_levels[female_CI_k], nrow(female_CI_chunk)), levels = female_CI_period_levels)
    contrasts(female_CI_newdata$period) <- female_CI_period_contrasts
    female_CI_newdata$site_id <- factor(rep(levels(female_CI_main_data$site_id)[1], nrow(female_CI_chunk)),
                              levels = levels(female_CI_main_data$site_id))
    # `site_id` provides a valid level; `re_formula = NA` excludes its random intercept.
    female_CI_ep <- brms::posterior_epred(fit_female_CI_main, newdata = female_CI_newdata,
                                re_formula = NA, draw_ids = female_CI_draw_ids)
    stopifnot(is.matrix(female_CI_ep), nrow(female_CI_ep) == length(female_CI_draw_ids),
              ncol(female_CI_ep) == nrow(female_CI_chunk), all(is.finite(female_CI_ep)))

    # Average predictions across periods with equal weights within each posterior draw
    female_CI_mean_draws <- female_CI_mean_draws + female_CI_ep / length(female_CI_period_levels)
    female_CI_q_period <- apply(female_CI_ep, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
    female_CI_period_results[[female_CI_k]] <- tibble(
      Longitude = female_CI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_CI_chunk$Latitude,
      period = female_CI_period_levels[female_CI_k], period_num = match(female_CI_period_levels[female_CI_k], PERIOD_CODES),
      female_CI_epred_median = female_CI_q_period[2, ],
      female_CI_epred_lower90 = female_CI_q_period[1, ],
      female_CI_epred_upper90 = female_CI_q_period[3, ]
    )
  }

  female_CI_q_all <- apply(female_CI_mean_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
  female_CI_all_period_chunks[[female_CI_j]] <- tibble(
    Longitude = female_CI_chunk$Longitude, Latitude = female_CI_chunk$Latitude,
    med = female_CI_q_all[2, ], low = female_CI_q_all[1, ], high = female_CI_q_all[3, ],
    period_all = "All represented periods (equal weights)"
  )
  female_CI_period_chunks[[female_CI_j]] <- bind_rows(female_CI_period_results)
}

pred_all_masked_female_CI <- bind_rows(female_CI_all_period_chunks)
female_CI_grid_periods <- bind_rows(female_CI_period_chunks)
# Generate predictions only for periods represented in the analysis sample; # do not assume that all seven periods are represented
readr::write_csv(pred_all_masked_female_CI,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_CI_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"))
readr::write_csv(female_CI_grid_periods,
                file.path(out_dir, "female_CI_grid_epred_primary_median_CI90.csv"))
```

### 9. Spatial maps

```{r female-ci-spatial-trends}
pred_all_masked_female_CI <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "female_CI_grid_all_periods_draw_average_CI90.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# # Site locations in the female analysis sample
sites_female_CI <- female_CI_main_data %>%
  group_by(site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    longitude = dplyr::first(longitude),
    latitude = dplyr::first(latitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

site_points_layer_female_CI <- geom_point(
  data = sites_female_CI,
  aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  shape = 21, fill = "red", colour = "red",
  stroke = 0.1, size = 0.35, alpha = 0.85
)


if (!exists("dem_plot")) {
  if (!exists("dem_cn")) {
    stop("Run the greyscale basemap preparation code first to create dem_cn")
  }
  female_CI_dem_factor <- max(
    1L, ceiling(max(ncol(dem_cn) / 1000, nrow(dem_cn) / 800))
  )
  female_CI_dem_small <- terra::aggregate(
    dem_cn, fact = female_CI_dem_factor, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE
  )
  dem_plot <- as.data.frame(female_CI_dem_small, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(dem_plot)[3] <- "grey"
}

female_CI_z_limits <- c(-2.5, 2.5)
common_z_scale_female_CI <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "PuOr")),
  limits = female_CI_z_limits,
  oob = scales::squish,
  name = "z-score",
  na.value = "transparent",
  guide = guide_colourbar(
    direction = "vertical",
    barheight = grid::unit(35, "mm"),
    barwidth = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
    frame.colour = "black",
    ticks.colour = "black"
  )
)

p_spatial_base_female_CI <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(
    data = dem_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = grey),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey35", guide = "none") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  coord_sf(
    crs = sf::st_crs(4326), default_crs = NULL,
    xlim = c(70, 140), ylim = c(10, 55), expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(70, 130, by = 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 50, by = 20)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white", colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
  )


p_female_CI_spatial_median <- p_spatial_base_female_CI +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_female_CI,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = med)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_female_CI +
  common_z_scale_female_CI +
  labs(title = "CI") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p_female_CI_spatial_median)

# Lower bound of the 90% credible interval
p_female_CI_spatial_lower90 <- p_spatial_base_female_CI +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_female_CI,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = low)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_female_CI +
  common_z_scale_female_CI +
  labs( y = "CI")

# Upper bound of the 90% credible interval
p_female_CI_spatial_upper90 <- p_spatial_base_female_CI +
  geom_tile(
    data = pred_all_masked_female_CI,
    aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = high)
  ) +
  site_points_layer_female_CI +
  common_z_scale_female_CI 

p_female_CI_spatial_bounds <-
  (p_female_CI_spatial_lower90 | p_female_CI_spatial_upper90) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 0)
  )
print(p_female_CI_spatial_bounds)
```

# Combined figures: run after all model analyses and individual plots

Use the previously generated plot objects to assemble combined figures for spatial posterior medians, spatial credible interval bounds, period trends, fixed effects, and random effects. This section produces all specified combined figures without refitting models or regenerating predictions.

First complete the plotting code for male and female FXL, FHD, TXL, HXL, RXL, BI, and CI, retaining the resulting plot objects. Comparisons of random effects also require the previously generated `site_re_plot_*` datasets.

Retain the original layouts and most filenames, and save all figures to `fig_dir`, as defined in Setup. Save each combined figure as PNG at 300 dpi and TIFF at either 300 or 600 dpi, according to the settings below.

No additional custom functions are introduced. Filenames, dimensions, and resolutions are managed together in the final export section.

Retain the different colour palettes for male and female spatial maps, with separate legends labelled by sex. Combine duplicate legends within each sex. Legends hidden in the individual posterior median maps are displayed again here.

`p_male_spatial` and `p_female_spatial` each retain their two-by-two layouts. The additional `p_combined_spatial` uses a two-by-four layout, with males in the top row and females in the bottom row.

For each trait, use a common horizontal axis range for male and female random-effect plots. Adjust plot heights according to the number of site-period groups displayed.

Retain the original individual plots and use the `_combined` suffix for modified versions used in combined figures.

Male and female z-scores remain standardised relative to their respective analysis samples; the same z-score may correspond to different original values.

## 1. Shared settings

```{r combined-figures-setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Check that all required individual plots and random-effect plotting datasets are available in the current session
combined_traits <- c("FXL", "FHD", "TXL", "HXL", "RXL", "BI", "CI")
combined_required_objects <- c(
  paste0("p_male_", combined_traits, "_spatial_median"),
  paste0("p_female_", combined_traits, "_spatial_median"),
  paste0("p_male_", combined_traits, "_spatial_lower90"),
  paste0("p_male_", combined_traits, "_spatial_upper90"),
  paste0("p_female_", combined_traits, "_spatial_lower90"),
  paste0("p_female_", combined_traits, "_spatial_upper90"),
  paste0("p_time_male_", tolower(combined_traits)),
  paste0("p_time_female_", tolower(combined_traits)),
  paste0("p_fixed_male_", tolower(combined_traits)),
  paste0("p_fixed_female_", tolower(combined_traits)),
  paste0("p_random_male_", c("FXL", "FHD", "TXL")),
  paste0("p_random_female_", c("FXL", "FHD", "TXL")),
  paste0("site_re_plot_male_", c("FXL", "FHD", "TXL")),
  paste0("site_re_plot_female_", c("FXL", "FHD", "TXL"))
)
combined_missing_objects <- combined_required_objects[
  !vapply(combined_required_objects, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)
]
if (length(combined_missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop("Generate the following objects first:\n",
     paste(combined_missing_objects, collapse = "\n"))
}

common_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
  legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
)

combined_spatial_theme <- theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.box = "vertical",
  legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.background = element_rect(
    fill = "white", colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2
  )
)

# Update legend titles and styles while retaining the colours and scale limits of the individual plots
combined_colourbar_theme <- theme(
  legend.key.height = grid::unit(35, "mm"),
  legend.key.width = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
  legend.frame = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
  legend.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")
)
combined_male_guide <- guide_colourbar(
  title = "Male\nz-score", direction = "vertical", order = 1,
  theme = combined_colourbar_theme
)
combined_female_guide <- guide_colourbar(
  title = "Female\nz-score", direction = "vertical", order = 2,
  theme = combined_colourbar_theme
)
```

## 2. Combined maps of spatial posterior medians

```{r combined-spatial-medians}
# Males: two-by-two layout for FXL / FHD / BI / CI
p_male_spatial <-
  ((p_male_FXL_spatial_median | p_male_FHD_spatial_median) /
   (p_male_BI_spatial_median  | p_male_CI_spatial_median)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme &
  guides(fill = combined_male_guide)

# Females: two-by-two layout for FXL / FHD / BI / CI
p_female_spatial <-
  ((p_female_FXL_spatial_median | p_female_FHD_spatial_median) /
   (p_female_BI_spatial_median  | p_female_CI_spatial_median)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme &
  guides(fill = combined_female_guide)

# TXL / HXL / RXL: males in the top row and females in the bottom row, with separate colour scales for each sex
p_male_spatial_thr_row <-
  ((p_male_TXL_spatial_median + labs(title = "TXL")) |
   (p_male_HXL_spatial_median + labs(title = "HXL")) |
   (p_male_RXL_spatial_median + labs(title = "RXL"))) &
  guides(fill = combined_male_guide)

p_female_spatial_thr_row <-
  ((p_female_TXL_spatial_median) |
   (p_female_HXL_spatial_median) |
   (p_female_RXL_spatial_median) ) &
  guides(fill = combined_female_guide)

p_spatial_2 <-
  (p_male_spatial_thr_row / p_female_spatial_thr_row) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1)) &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme

# FXL / FHD / BI / CI: two-by-four layout, with males in the top row and females in the bottom row
p_male_spatial_core_row <-
  ((p_male_FXL_spatial_median + labs(title = "FXL")) |
   (p_male_FHD_spatial_median + labs(title = "FHD")) |
   (p_male_BI_spatial_median  + labs(title = "BI")) |
   (p_male_CI_spatial_median  + labs(title = "CI"))) &
  guides(fill = combined_male_guide)

p_female_spatial_core_row <-
  ((p_female_FXL_spatial_median) |
   (p_female_FHD_spatial_median) |
   (p_female_BI_spatial_median) |
   (p_female_CI_spatial_median )) &
  guides(fill = combined_female_guide)

p_combined_spatial <-
  (p_male_spatial_core_row / p_female_spatial_core_row) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1)) &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme
```

## 3. Lower and upper bounds of the 90% credible intervals for spatial predictions

The left column shows lower bounds and the right column shows upper bounds. Use the existing interval-bound plots without recalculating the intervals.

```{r combined-spatial-bounds}
p_male_spatial_uncertain_1 <-
  ((p_male_FXL_spatial_lower90 | p_male_FXL_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_male_FHD_spatial_lower90 | p_male_FHD_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_male_BI_spatial_lower90  | p_male_BI_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_male_CI_spatial_lower90  | p_male_CI_spatial_upper90)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme &
  guides(fill = combined_male_guide)

p_female_spatial_uncertain_1 <-
  ((p_female_FXL_spatial_lower90 | p_female_FXL_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_female_FHD_spatial_lower90 | p_female_FHD_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_female_BI_spatial_lower90  | p_female_BI_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_female_CI_spatial_lower90  | p_female_CI_spatial_upper90)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme &
  guides(fill = combined_female_guide)

p_male_spatial_uncertain_2 <-
  ((p_male_TXL_spatial_lower90 | p_male_TXL_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_male_HXL_spatial_lower90 | p_male_HXL_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_male_RXL_spatial_lower90 | p_male_RXL_spatial_upper90)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme &
  guides(fill = combined_male_guide)

p_female_spatial_uncertain_2 <-
  ((p_female_TXL_spatial_lower90 | p_female_TXL_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_female_HXL_spatial_lower90 | p_female_HXL_spatial_upper90) /
   (p_female_RXL_spatial_lower90 | p_female_RXL_spatial_upper90)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  common_theme & combined_spatial_theme &
  guides(fill = combined_female_guide)
```

## 4. Combined plots of period trends

Each row represents one trait, with males on the left and females on the right. Retain the dual vertical axes from the individual plots: the left axis shows z-scores, and the right axis shows back-transformed values for the corresponding sex and trait. For BI and CI, the right axis shows index values.

```{r combined-temporal}
p_temporal_body_size <-
  ((p_time_male_fxl | p_time_female_fxl) /
   (p_time_male_fhd | p_time_female_fhd)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme

p_temporal_proportion <-
  ((p_time_male_bi | p_time_female_bi) /
   (p_time_male_ci | p_time_female_ci)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme

p_temporal_upper <-
  ((p_time_male_hxl | p_time_female_hxl) /
   (p_time_male_rxl | p_time_female_rxl)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme

p_temporal_thr <-
  ((p_time_male_txl | p_time_female_txl) /
   (p_time_male_hxl | p_time_female_hxl) /
   (p_time_male_rxl | p_time_female_rxl)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme
```

## 5. Combined plots of fixed effects

Each row represents one trait, with males on the left and females on the right. Retain the FXL coefficient in the FHD row, as shown in the individual plots.

```{r combined-fixed-effects}
p_combined_fixed <-
  ((p_fixed_male_fxl | p_fixed_female_fxl) /
   (p_fixed_male_fhd | p_fixed_female_fhd) /
   (p_fixed_male_bi  | p_fixed_female_bi) /
   (p_fixed_male_ci  | p_fixed_female_ci)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme

p_combined_fixed_thr <-
  ((p_fixed_male_txl | p_fixed_female_txl) /
   (p_fixed_male_hxl | p_fixed_female_hxl) /
   (p_fixed_male_rxl | p_fixed_female_rxl)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme
```

## 6. Combined plots of random effects

For FXL, FHD, and TXL, use a common horizontal axis range for males and females within each trait. Retain the original selection and ordering of site-period groups in each plot.

Label the FXL and FHD rows with the corresponding trait names.

```{r combined-random-effects}
common_grid_theme <- theme(
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
  panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
)

# FXL: common horizontal axis range
combined_random_FXL_breaks <- pretty(range(
  site_re_plot_male_FXL$r_site_id,
  site_re_plot_female_FXL$r_site_id,
  na.rm = TRUE
), n = 4)
combined_random_FXL_limits <- range(combined_random_FXL_breaks)
combined_random_FXL_scale <- scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = combined_random_FXL_breaks, minor_breaks = NULL,
  expand = expansion(mult = 0)
)

p_random_male_FXL_combined <- p_random_male_FXL +
  combined_random_FXL_scale +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = combined_random_FXL_limits) +
  common_grid_theme + labs(title = "Male: FXL")

p_random_female_FXL_combined <- p_random_female_FXL +
  combined_random_FXL_scale +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = combined_random_FXL_limits) +
  common_grid_theme + labs(title = "Female: FXL")

# FHD: common horizontal axis range
combined_random_FHD_breaks <- pretty(range(
  site_re_plot_male_FHD$r_site_id,
  site_re_plot_female_FHD$r_site_id,
  na.rm = TRUE
), n = 4)
combined_random_FHD_limits <- range(combined_random_FHD_breaks)
combined_random_FHD_scale <- scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = combined_random_FHD_breaks, minor_breaks = NULL,
  expand = expansion(mult = 0)
)

p_random_male_FHD_combined <- p_random_male_FHD +
  combined_random_FHD_scale +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = combined_random_FHD_limits) +
  common_grid_theme + labs(title = "Male: FHD")

p_random_female_FHD_combined <- p_random_female_FHD +
  combined_random_FHD_scale +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = combined_random_FHD_limits) +
  common_grid_theme + labs(title = "Female: FHD")

# TXL: common horizontal axis range
combined_random_TXL_breaks <- pretty(range(
  site_re_plot_male_TXL$r_site_id,
  site_re_plot_female_TXL$r_site_id,
  na.rm = TRUE
), n = 4)
combined_random_TXL_limits <- range(combined_random_TXL_breaks)
combined_random_TXL_scale <- scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = combined_random_TXL_breaks, minor_breaks = NULL,
  expand = expansion(mult = 0)
)

p_random_male_TXL_combined <- p_random_male_TXL +
  combined_random_TXL_scale +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = combined_random_TXL_limits) +
  common_grid_theme + labs(title = "Male: TXL")

p_random_female_TXL_combined <- p_random_female_TXL +
  combined_random_TXL_scale +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = combined_random_TXL_limits) +
  common_grid_theme + labs(title = "Female: TXL")

# Allow sufficient plot height for site-period group labels; specify the desired heights in inches here
combined_random_FXL_height <- max(6, 1.5 + 0.16 * max(
  dplyr::n_distinct(site_re_plot_male_FXL$site_id),
  dplyr::n_distinct(site_re_plot_female_FXL$site_id)
))
combined_random_FHD_height <- max(6, 1.5 + 0.16 * max(
  dplyr::n_distinct(site_re_plot_male_FHD$site_id),
  dplyr::n_distinct(site_re_plot_female_FHD$site_id)
))
combined_random_TXL_height <- max(6, 1.5 + 0.16 * max(
  dplyr::n_distinct(site_re_plot_male_TXL$site_id),
  dplyr::n_distinct(site_re_plot_female_TXL$site_id)
))

p_combined_random <-
  ((p_random_male_FXL_combined | p_random_female_FXL_combined) /
   (p_random_male_FHD_combined | p_random_female_FHD_combined)) +
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    heights = c(combined_random_FXL_height, combined_random_FHD_height)
  ) & common_theme

p_random_fxl <-
  (p_random_male_FXL_combined | p_random_female_FXL_combined) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme

p_random_fhd <-
  (p_random_male_FHD_combined | p_random_female_FHD_combined) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme

p_random_txl <-
  (p_random_male_TXL_combined | p_random_female_TXL_combined) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & common_theme
```

```{r combined-figures-preview, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
print(p_male_spatial)
print(p_temporal_body_size)
```

## 8. Save all combined figures

The names in the list below are the output filenames without extensions. Their order matches the dimensions table.

Save each figure as PNG followed by TIFF. Progress messages display the current filename.

```{r combined-figures-save}
combined_plots <- list(
  combined_male_spatial2 = p_male_spatial,
  combined_female_spatial2 = p_female_spatial,
  combined_spatial_thr2 = p_spatial_2,
  combined_spatial_both_sexes_FXL_FHD_BI_CI = p_combined_spatial,
  combined_male_uncertain_1_2 = p_male_spatial_uncertain_1,
  combined_female_uncertain_1_2 = p_female_spatial_uncertain_1,
  combined_male_uncertain_2_2 = p_male_spatial_uncertain_2,
  combined_female_uncertain_2_2 = p_female_spatial_uncertain_2,
  combined_temporal_bodysize = p_temporal_body_size,
  combined_temporal_proportion = p_temporal_proportion,
  combined_temporal_upper = p_temporal_upper,
  combined_temporal_thr = p_temporal_thr,
  fixed_effects = p_combined_fixed,
  fixed_effects_thr = p_combined_fixed_thr,
  random_effects = p_combined_random,
  random_effects_fxl = p_random_fxl,
  random_effects_fhd = p_random_fhd,
  random_effects_txl = p_random_txl
)

combined_figure_settings <- tibble::tibble(
  file_base = names(combined_plots),
  width_in = c(
    10, 10, 12, 16,
    8, 8, 8, 8,
    10, 10, 10, 10,
    8, 8,
    10, 10, 10, 10
  ),
  height_in = c(
    7, 7, 6, 7,
    10, 10, 8, 8,
    6, 6, 6, 10,
    10, 8,
    combined_random_FXL_height + combined_random_FHD_height,
    combined_random_FXL_height,
    combined_random_FHD_height,
    combined_random_TXL_height
  ),
  tiff_dpi = c(rep(600, 4), rep(300, 4), rep(600, 4), rep(300, 6)),
  png_dpi = 300
)
stopifnot(nrow(combined_figure_settings) == length(combined_plots))

readr::write_csv(
  combined_figure_settings,
  file.path(fig_dir, "combined_figure_settings.csv")
)

for (combined_i in seq_along(combined_plots)) {
  message(
    "Saving ", combined_i, " / ", length(combined_plots), ": ",
    combined_figure_settings$file_base[combined_i]
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      fig_dir, paste0(combined_figure_settings$file_base[combined_i], ".png")
    ),
    plot = combined_plots[[combined_i]],
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    width = combined_figure_settings$width_in[combined_i],
    height = combined_figure_settings$height_in[combined_i],
    units = "in", dpi = combined_figure_settings$png_dpi[combined_i],
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      fig_dir, paste0(combined_figure_settings$file_base[combined_i], ".tiff")
    ),
    plot = combined_plots[[combined_i]],
    device = ragg::agg_tiff,
    width = combined_figure_settings$width_in[combined_i],
    height = combined_figure_settings$height_in[combined_i],
    units = "in", dpi = combined_figure_settings$tiff_dpi[combined_i],
    compression = "lzw", bg = "white"
  )
}

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo_combined_figures.txt")
)
message("All combined figures have been saved to: ",
        normalizePath(fig_dir, winslash = "/"))
```
